blocks.name: Clean French Mirepoix
blocks.description: Onion, carrot, and celery sweated slowly in fat without any color. It adds a quiet savory sweetness that supports delicate soups, pilafs, piccatas, and pan sauces without taking over.

steps.title: Dice small
steps.text: Cut the onion, carrot, and celery into an even 1/4-inch dice, or pulse each separately in a food processor until finely chopped but not mushy. Small pieces melt into sauces faster.

steps.title: Sweat, don't brown
steps.text: Melt the butter in a wide pot over medium-low heat. Add the vegetables and salt, stir to coat, then cover. Cook 25–30 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until completely soft, sweet, and translucent. If anything starts to color, lower the heat and add a splash of water.

steps.title: Loosen
steps.text: Uncover, add the stock and MSG (if using), and simmer 3–4 minutes until most of the liquid is absorbed and the mixture looks glossy and spoonable.

steps.title: Optional texture
steps.text: For a smoother base that disappears into sauces, blitz about half the batch with an immersion blender. Leave the rest chunky.

steps.title: Cool and portion
steps.text: Spread on a plate to cool for 15 minutes. Spoon 2 tablespoons into each well of a silicone ice-cube tray and level the tops.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Freeze uncovered 4–6 hours until solid. Pop the cubes out into a labeled zip-top bag, press out the air, and return to the freezer.

notes: Color is the enemy here: browned mirepoix belongs to Base 2's territory.
Doubles easily. Use your widest pot so the vegetables sweat instead of steaming in a deep pile.

blocks.name: Roasted Allium-Tomato Jam
blocks.description: Deeply caramelized onions, sweet roasted garlic, and tomato paste fried until brick red, finished with balsamic. It gives you hours-of-braising depth in a single cube.

steps.title: Roast the garlic
steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Slice the top 1/4 inch off each garlic head, drizzle with 1 tsp oil, wrap in foil, and roast 40 minutes until soft and golden. Do this while the onions cook.

steps.title: Caramelize the onions
steps.text: Heat the remaining oil in a wide heavy pot over medium. Add the onions and 1 tsp salt. Cook 40–45 minutes, stirring every few minutes and scraping the bottom, until jammy and deep mahogany. When the pan gets sticky, add 2 tbsp water and scrape.

steps.title: Fry the paste
steps.text: Push the onions aside, add the tomato paste to the bare pot, and fry 4–5 minutes, stirring, until it turns from bright red to dark brick red and smells sweet. This step builds most of the umami.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Squeeze the roasted garlic cloves into the pot. Add the balsamic, sugar, MSG, remaining salt, and 1/2 cup water. Simmer 3 minutes, scraping up everything stuck to the bottom.

steps.title: Blend to jam
steps.text: Blend with an immersion blender until mostly smooth and spreadable, like a thick jam. Add a splash of water if it's too stiff to blend.

steps.title: Cool, portion, freeze
steps.text: Cool 15 minutes, spoon 2 tablespoons into each tray well, and freeze 4–6 hours. Transfer the cubes to a labeled bag.

notes: Don't rush the onions over high heat. They scorch outside before the sugars develop inside.
A slow cooker on high with the lid ajar caramelizes onions hands-off in about 8 hours.

blocks.name: Green Citrus & Herb Slurry
blocks.description: Charred poblanos, herbs with their stems, scallions, ginger, olive oil, and citrus, blended until vivid green. Cook with it for verde and green-curry dishes, or thaw it as an instant dressing, chutney, or marinade.
blocks.storage: Up to 2 months frozen (color fades after that)

steps.title: Char the poblanos
steps.text: Char the poblanos directly over a gas flame or under the broiler, turning, 8–10 minutes until blackened all over. Seal them in a bowl under a plate for 10 minutes to steam.

steps.title: Peel and seed
steps.text: Rub off the blackened skin with a paper towel (don't rinse, you'll lose flavor). Remove the stems and seeds.

steps.title: Optional: lock in the green
steps.text: For the brightest color, dunk the cilantro and parsley in boiling water for 10 seconds, then into ice water. Squeeze dry. Blanched herbs stay green in the freezer much longer.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the poblanos, herbs, scallions, ginger, garlic, citrus zest and juice, olive oil, and salt until smooth and pourable, about 1 minute. Add up to 1/4 cup cold water if needed. Taste: it should be bright, salty, and tangy.

steps.title: Freeze quickly
steps.text: Pour straight into the tray, 2 tablespoons per well, and freeze right away. Speed keeps the color vivid. After 4–6 hours, transfer to a bag and press out all the air.

notes: Cooking with it: melt a cube into a hot pan for verde skillets and green curries.
Cold use: thaw 20–30 seconds in the microwave and whisk with yogurt or oil for dressings and dips.

blocks.name: Velvet Garlic-Nut Cream
blocks.description: Soaked cashews (or sunflower seeds) blended with roasted garlic, mild broth, and lemon into a dense, stable cream. It makes any pan sauce silky and won't split or curdle the way dairy can.

ingredients.item: raw cashews (or sunflower seeds for nut-free)

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Cover the cashews with boiling water and soak 15 minutes (or cold water for 4 hours). Drain and rinse.

steps.title: Soften the garlic
steps.text: Peel the cloves and simmer them in the broth 10–12 minutes until completely soft and mellow. You can also use a head of roasted garlic from the Base 2 batch.

steps.title: Blend until velvety
steps.text: Blend the cashews, garlic, warm broth, lemon zest and juice, salt, and nutritional yeast on high for 2 full minutes, scraping down once, until perfectly smooth with no grit. It should be thick like Greek yogurt.

steps.title: Portion and freeze
steps.text: Spoon 2 tablespoons into each tray well (it's thick, so press it down with the back of a spoon). Freeze 4–6 hours, then bag.

notes: A high-speed blender gives the silkiest result. With a regular blender, soak overnight and blend longer.
Sunflower seeds work for nut-free kitchens. They can turn slightly green when cooked with acid, which is harmless.

blocks.name: Euro-Bistro
blocks.tagline: Red wine, cracked pepper, thyme & Dijon
blocks.description: A full bottle of red wine reduced to a syrup with shallots, garlic, woodsy herbs, cracked peppercorns, and Dijon. It's the backbone of steakhouse pan sauces, French and Italian braises, and herby Mediterranean dishes.

steps.title: Sweat the aromatics
steps.text: Heat the oil in a wide saucepan over medium. Add the shallots and garlic and cook 4–5 minutes until soft and lightly golden.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.text: Add the thyme, rosemary, and cracked pepper and stir 1 minute until very fragrant.

steps.title: Reduce the wine
steps.text: Pour in the whole bottle of wine and raise the heat to a strong simmer. Reduce 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until only about 2/3 cup remains and it's syrupy enough to coat a spoon.

steps.title: Finish off the heat
steps.text: Remove from heat and whisk in the Dijon, Worcestershire, and salt. Taste: it should be intensely winey, peppery, and herbal. It's a concentrate, so strong is right.

steps.title: Freeze small
steps.text: Cool 10 minutes, then portion 1 tablespoon per well (use a mini tray if you have one). Freeze 4 hours and bag.

notes: No wine? Use 2 cups unsweetened grape juice plus 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, reduced the same way.
Boosters are more concentrated than bases, so they use 1-tablespoon cubes.

blocks.name: East & SE Asian Umami
blocks.description: A ginger-scallion confit loaded with lemongrass and galangal, seasoned with tamari and Shaoxing wine and enriched with sesame oil and coconut cream. It powers everything from lo mein to Tom Kha.

steps.title: Mince the aromatics
steps.text: Pulse the ginger, lemongrass, galangal, and garlic in a food processor until very finely minced. Put them in a heatproof bowl with the scallions.

steps.title: Sizzle
steps.text: Heat the neutral oil in a small saucepan until shimmering (about 350°F). Carefully pour it over the aromatics. It will sizzle hard, blooming the oils without browning. Stir well.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Return everything to the saucepan with the tamari, Shaoxing wine, and sugar. Simmer gently 3–4 minutes until the raw edge of the ginger is gone.

steps.title: Enrich
steps.text: Off the heat, stir in the sesame oil and coconut cream until combined. It will look loose and creamy.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Cool 10 minutes and portion 1 tablespoon per well, stirring between scoops so every cube gets oil and solids. Freeze 4 hours and bag.

notes: Use a freezer-only tray. Ginger and lemongrass can perfume silicone permanently.
Lemongrass: peel off the tough outer layers and use only the pale bottom 4–5 inches.

blocks.name: South Asian Masala (Tadka)
blocks.tagline: Bloomed mustard seed, cumin, curry leaf & hing
blocks.description: A classic tadka (whole spices bloomed in hot ghee) frozen at its peak with fresh ginger, garlic, green chili, and ground spices. One cube instantly turns a dal, curry, or hash into the real thing.

steps.title: Set up first
steps.text: Measure everything before you start. A tadka moves in seconds. Keep the pan's lid nearby for splatter.

steps.title: Pop the seeds
steps.text: Heat the ghee in a small saucepan over medium-high until shimmering. Add the mustard seeds; when they begin to crackle and pop (20–30 seconds), add the cumin seeds and stir 15 seconds until a shade darker.

steps.title: Leaves and hing
steps.text: Add the curry leaves (they'll spit, so stand back) and the asafoetida. Stir 10 seconds.

steps.title: Aromatics
steps.text: Lower to medium. Add the ginger, garlic, and chilies and cook 2 minutes until softened and fragrant but not browned.

steps.title: Ground spices
steps.text: Turn off the heat. Stir in the turmeric, coriander, chili powder, and salt; the residual heat blooms them in 30 seconds without burning.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Cool 10 minutes, stir, and portion 1 tablespoon per well so each cube gets plenty of fat. The fat sets solid. Freeze 4 hours and bag.

notes: Burnt cumin tastes bitter. If the seeds go black, start over. It only costs a few cents.
Find curry leaves and hing at Indian grocers. Curry leaves freeze well, so buy extra.

blocks.name: Latin & Tex-Mex Adobo
blocks.tagline: Smoky chipotle, ancho, cumin & Mexican oregano
blocks.description: Toasted ancho chilies and smoky chipotles blended with garlic, spices, and cider vinegar, then fried into a thick, brick-red paste. It's deep, earthy, tangy heat for tacos, chilis, and enchilada sauces.

steps.title: Toast the chilies
steps.text: Press the dried chilies flat in a dry skillet over medium heat, 20–30 seconds per side, until fragrant and slightly pliable. Don't let them smoke or blacken or they'll turn bitter.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Cover with boiling water and soak 15 minutes until soft. Reserve 1/2 cup of the soaking liquid.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend the soaked chilies, the whole can of chipotles with their sauce, garlic, oregano, cumin, cinnamon, vinegar, honey, salt, and the reserved liquid until completely smooth.

steps.title: Fry the adobo
steps.text: Heat the oil in a deep saucepan over medium-high. Pour in the purée (it will spatter) and cook 8–10 minutes, stirring often, until it darkens, thickens to a paste, and the oil starts to separate around the edges.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Cool 10 minutes and portion 1 tablespoon per well. Freeze 4 hours and bag.

notes: Heat level: for milder, use only half the chipotles; for hotter, add 2 dried chiles de árbol.
Frying the purée is the secret. It turns raw, sharp chili into a deep, rounded adobo.

recipes.title: Masala Egg Bhurji Toast
recipes.description: Soft, curry-leaf-scented Indian scrambled eggs piled onto buttered toast. Breakfast in under ten minutes.

steps.title: Bloom the cubes
steps.text: Set a nonstick skillet over medium heat with the butter. Add 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C plus 1 tbsp water. Stir for 60–90 seconds until melted, glossy, and the mustard seeds start to pop.

steps.title: Soften the tomato
steps.text: Add the diced tomato and a pinch of salt. Cook 1–2 minutes, mashing with the spatula, until it collapses into the masala.

steps.title: Scramble low and slow
steps.text: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pour them in. Lower the heat and stir slowly with a spatula, pulling curds from the edges, for 2–3 minutes. Pull the pan off the heat while the eggs still look slightly wet — they finish in the residual heat.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Fold in most of the cilantro and the garam masala if using. Meanwhile toast the bread in a second pan or toaster and butter it.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile the bhurji onto toast, top with remaining cilantro, and squeeze over lime.

notes: Booster C carries the green chili heat; add a finely chopped fresh chili if you like it hotter.
Wrap leftovers in a warm paratha or flour tortilla for a next-day lunch roll.

recipes.title: Salsa Verde Breakfast Tacos
recipes.description: Tangy green-chile scrambled eggs (or shredded chicken) in warm corn tortillas with avocado and cotija.

ingredients.item: pickled red onion or hot sauce

steps.title: Melt the verde
steps.text: In a skillet over medium heat, melt 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster D with 2 tbsp water, stirring until it becomes a loose, bright green-red sauce (about 90 seconds).

steps.title: Scramble into the sauce
steps.text: Pour in the beaten eggs with a pinch of salt. Gently fold for 2–3 minutes until just set, so the sauce streaks through soft curds.

steps.title: Glaze the chicken
steps.text: Add the shredded chicken and toss for 2–3 minutes until heated through and every strand is coated. Add a splash more water if it looks dry.

steps.title: Warm tortillas
steps.text: While the filling cooks, char the tortillas directly over a gas flame or in a dry pan, 20–30 seconds per side. Stack them in a towel to stay soft.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Fill each tortilla, then top with sliced avocado, crumbled cotija, a squeeze of lime, and pickled onion or hot sauce.

notes: Make both proteins at once: scramble 3 eggs, then add 1 cup chicken for an extra-hearty version.

recipes.title: Smoky Chipotle Deviled Eggs
recipes.description: Deviled eggs whipped with Velvet Cream instead of mayo and spiked with adobo. Great for meal-prepped snacks.

steps.title: Thaw the cubes
steps.text: Set 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster D in a small bowl to soften while the eggs cook (or microwave 15–20 seconds — just softened, not hot).

steps.title: Cook the eggs
steps.text: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook for exactly 10 minutes. Transfer to an ice bath for at least 3 minutes, then peel.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.text: Halve the eggs and pop the yolks into the bowl with the softened cubes. Add a squeeze of lime and a pinch of salt and mash with a fork until completely smooth. It should be creamy and pipeable; add 1 tsp water if it is too stiff.

steps.title: Fill and finish
steps.text: Spoon or pipe the filling into the whites. Dust with smoked paprika and top with chives and pepitas.

notes: Keeps 2 days in the fridge in a covered container — garnish right before eating.
Swap Booster D for Booster C for a curry-spiced version.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Lettuce Cups
recipes.description: Crispy, herby ground meat in the style of Thai larb, spooned into crunchy lettuce leaves. A light lunch or a big snack.

steps.title: Brown hard
steps.text: Heat a large skillet over high heat with 1 tsp oil. Add the ground meat in an even layer, season with salt, and leave it alone for 3 minutes to form a deep brown crust before breaking it up.
Turkey is lean — add an extra 1 tsp oil with it so it browns rather than steams.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Push the meat aside, drop in 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster B with 2 tbsp water. Once melted (about 60 seconds), toss everything together and cook 2 minutes until the pan is almost dry and the meat is glossy.

steps.title: Season off the heat
steps.text: Kill the heat. Stir in the fish sauce, the juice of the lime, and most of the torn herbs. Taste: it should be salty, sour, and fragrant. Adjust with more lime or fish sauce.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon into lettuce cups and top with cucumber, remaining herbs, and peanuts. Add a spoonful of rice to each cup if you want it more filling.

notes: For a classic larb crunch, toast 1 tbsp raw rice in a dry pan until golden, grind it, and sprinkle on top.

recipes.title: Ginger-Scallion Chicken Rice Bowls
recipes.description: Golden seared chicken thighs tossed in a gingery, savory glaze over jasmine rice with quick-pickled cucumbers.

steps.title: Quick pickle
steps.text: Thinly slice the cucumbers, toss with the rice vinegar and a pinch each of salt and sugar. Set aside while you cook.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: Toss the chicken with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt. Sear in 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, undisturbed for 4 minutes, then flip and cook 3–4 minutes more until golden and cooked through (165°F).

steps.title: Crisp the tofu
steps.text: Toss the tofu with the cornstarch and a pinch of salt. Fry in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high heat, turning every 2 minutes, for about 8 minutes until crisp on most sides.

steps.title: Melt the glaze
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium. Add 1 cube Base 1, 2 cubes Booster B, the soy sauce, and 3 tbsp water. Stir until the cubes melt and the sauce turns glossy and clings to the protein, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Scallions
steps.text: Slice the scallions; toss the whites into the pan for the last 30 seconds and save the greens for topping.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Divide warm rice between bowls, top with the glazed protein and pan sauce, drained cucumbers, scallion greens, sesame seeds, and chili crisp.

notes: Packs well for 3 days of lunches — store the pickles separately so they stay crunchy.

recipes.title: Chipotle Taco Skillet
recipes.description: Smoky, saucy ground meat with black beans and corn — spoon it into tortillas, over rice, or eat it straight from the pan.

steps.title: Brown the meat
steps.text: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the meat, season with 1/2 tsp salt, and cook 5–6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned with crispy edges. Spoon off excess fat if there is more than 1 tbsp.
Start the turkey in 1 tbsp oil and let it sit undisturbed for 2–3 minutes before breaking it up so it develops color.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.text: Add 2 cubes Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, and 1/2 cup water. Stir as the cubes melt into a thick, brick-red sauce, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the black beans and corn. Simmer 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick enough that a spoon dragged through leaves a trail.

steps.title: Melt the cheese
steps.text: Scatter the cheese over the top, cover for 1 minute to melt, then squeeze lime over everything.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve from the skillet with warm tortillas or rice, sour cream, and chopped cilantro.

notes: Freezes well before the cheese step — reheat with a splash of water.
Turn leftovers into nachos or stuff them into baked sweet potatoes.

recipes.title: Green Herb Chicken & Chickpea Grain Bowl
recipes.description: Lemony, herb-marinated chicken (or crispy chickpeas) over warm farro with feta, cucumber, and a Green Citrus vinaigrette.

ingredients.item: boneless skinless chicken breast or thighs

steps.title: Start the grains
steps.text: Cook the farro in salted boiling water according to the package (usually 10–12 minutes for quick-cook). Drain well.

steps.title: Make the dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 (microwave 20 seconds) and whisk with 2 tbsp olive oil, the juice of half the lemon, and a pinch of salt. This is your vinaigrette.

steps.title: Sear the chicken
steps.text: Pound the chicken to an even 1/2-inch thickness and season with salt. Sear in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat, 4–5 minutes per side, until 165°F. Rest 3 minutes, then slice.

steps.title: Crisp the chickpeas
steps.text: Fry the dried chickpeas in 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat for 7–8 minutes, shaking the pan, until blistered and crunchy. Season with salt.

steps.title: Herb glaze
steps.text: Into the hot pan (protein removed or still in), add the remaining 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A with 2 tbsp water. Stir 60 seconds until it emulsifies, then toss the protein back through it.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Toss the warm farro with half the vinaigrette. Top with the glazed protein, cucumber, halved tomatoes, feta, and olives. Drizzle with the remaining vinaigrette and a squeeze of lemon.

notes: Assemble jars for the week: dressing on the bottom, then grains, protein, and vegetables, with feta on top.

recipes.title: Creamy Tikka Masala Skillet
recipes.description: Charred chicken or turkey in a rich tomato-cream tikka gravy built from three freezer cubes. Restaurant depth on a weeknight.

steps.title: Quick marinade
steps.text: Start the rice. In a bowl, toss the protein with the yogurt, 1 tsp garam masala, and 1 tsp salt. Let it sit while the pan heats (even 10 minutes helps).

steps.title: Char
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over high heat. Add the protein in a single layer (work in batches if needed) and leave it 3 minutes to char, then turn and cook 2 minutes more. It does not need to be cooked through yet. Transfer to a plate.
Turkey breast dries out quickly — sear only 2 minutes per side so it finishes gently in the sauce.

steps.title: Build the gravy
steps.text: Lower heat to medium. Add 2 cubes Base 2 and 2 cubes Booster C with 1/4 cup water, scraping up the browned bits. Once melted, add the crushed tomatoes and simmer 8 minutes until thickened and darker red.

steps.title: Make it creamy
steps.text: Stir in 1 cube Base 4 until melted and the sauce turns a deep orange. Add the remaining 1 tsp garam masala and the kasuri methi crushed between your palms.

steps.title: Finish the protein
steps.text: Return the protein and its juices. Simmer gently 6–8 minutes until cooked through (165°F). Thin with water if the gravy gets too thick; season with salt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over basmati rice or with warm naan, scattered with cilantro.

notes: Doubles easily and freezes for up to 3 months.
For more heat, add 1/2 tsp Kashmiri chili powder with the tomatoes.

recipes.title: Bistro Peppercorn Meatballs
recipes.description: Tender herb meatballs browned and simmered in a red-wine peppercorn cream sauce. Serve over pasta or mashed potatoes.

ingredients.item: ground beef or a beef/pork mix

steps.title: Panade
steps.text: In a large bowl, mash the panko with the milk and let it soak 2 minutes. This is what keeps the meatballs tender.

steps.title: Mix and roll
steps.text: Add the meat, egg, parmesan, 2 tbsp chopped parsley, 1 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper. Mix with your hands until just combined — don't overwork. Roll into 16 golf-ball-sized meatballs.
Turkey mixture is soft; wet your hands with cold water while rolling so it doesn't stick.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Start a pot of salted water for the pasta. Brown the meatballs in 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat, turning, about 6 minutes total until well colored on all sides. They will finish cooking in the sauce.

steps.title: Peppercorn sauce
steps.text: Spoon out all but 1 tbsp fat. Add 1 cube Base 1, 2 cubes Booster A, the cracked pepper, and the broth. Scrape up the browned bits as the cubes melt, then simmer 3 minutes to reduce slightly.

steps.title: Cream and simmer
steps.text: Stir in 2 cubes Base 4 until the sauce turns silky and pale tan. Nestle the meatballs back in, cover, and simmer on medium-low 8–10 minutes until cooked through (165°F). Meanwhile cook the pasta.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Toss the drained pasta with a few spoonfuls of the sauce, top with meatballs and more sauce, and finish with chopped parsley and extra cracked pepper.

notes: Freeze browned, uncooked-through meatballs on a tray, then bag them — they go straight into the sauce from frozen (add 5 minutes).
For mashed potatoes instead of pasta, boil peeled chunks 15 minutes and mash with butter and a splash of the sauce.

recipes.title: Steak au Poivre with Crispy Skillet Potatoes
recipes.description: Pepper-crusted steak with a creamy cognac-free peppercorn pan sauce built from two cubes, plus crispy potatoes from the same pan.

steps.title: Potatoes first
steps.text: Microwave the halved potatoes in a covered bowl with 2 tbsp water for 5 minutes until just tender. Drain and pat dry.

steps.title: Crust the steaks
steps.text: Pat the steaks very dry, season generously with salt, and press the crushed peppercorns into both sides. Let them sit while the skillet heats.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a heavy skillet over high heat until shimmering. Sear the steaks 3–4 minutes per side for medium-rare (130°F), adding the butter for the last minute and basting. Rest on a board.

steps.title: Crisp potatoes
steps.text: In the same pan over medium-high, add the remaining oil and the potatoes cut-side down. Cook 5–6 minutes without moving until deeply golden. Salt and move to plates.

steps.title: Peppercorn sauce
steps.text: Lower heat to medium. Add the broth, 2 cubes Booster A, and 1 cube Base 4, scraping up the fond. Stir 90 seconds until the sauce is smooth and coats a spoon. Pour in any steak resting juices.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slice the steak against the grain, spoon the sauce over, and scatter with chives.

notes: Swap steak for thick pork chops (cook to 140°F) using the same sauce.

recipes.title: Lemon-Caper Piccata with Spaghetti
recipes.description: Thin, golden cutlets in a buttery lemon-caper sauce tossed with spaghetti — bistro classic, weeknight speed.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti 1 minute shy of al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.

steps.title: Prep cutlets
steps.text: Pound the halved breasts to an even 1/4 inch. Season with salt and dredge lightly in flour.

steps.title: Prep cutlets
steps.text: Turkey cutlets are already thin — season with salt and dredge lightly in flour.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil and 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook the cutlets 2–3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through (165°F). Move to a plate.

steps.title: Pan sauce
steps.text: Lower heat to medium. Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster A, the capers, juice of the lemon, and 1/4 cup pasta water. Scrape up the browned bits and simmer 1 minute, then swirl in the remaining butter until glossy.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the drained spaghetti and toss until coated, loosening with more pasta water. Top with the cutlets, extra sauce, and parsley.

recipes.title: Tuscan Sausage & White Bean Skillet
recipes.description: Browned Italian sausage, creamy cannellini, and wilted kale in a garlicky tomato pan sauce. Mop it up with crusty bread.

steps.title: Brown the sausage
steps.text: Crumble the sausage into a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook 6 minutes until well browned. Leave the fat in the pan.

steps.title: Bean-only start
steps.text: Skip the sausage; warm 2 tbsp olive oil in the skillet and fry one can of the beans 4 minutes until a few split and crisp — this adds meaty texture.

steps.title: Build sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster A, red pepper flakes, and the broth. Stir until melted into a glossy red sauce, about 90 seconds.

steps.title: Beans and greens
steps.text: Add the beans and kale, cover, and simmer 5 minutes until the kale is tender. Lightly mash a few beans to thicken.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Finish with parmesan, a drizzle of olive oil, and torn crusty bread.

recipes.title: French Onion Smothered Chicken
recipes.description: Seared chicken thighs smothered in jammy onions and melted Gruyère, like the soup but a full dinner.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Season the thighs with salt and pepper. Sear in 1 tbsp oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high, 5 minutes per side, until deeply browned. Remove.

steps.title: Onions
steps.text: Add the sliced onion with a pinch of salt and cook 6–7 minutes, stirring, until soft and golden.

steps.title: Gravy
steps.text: Stir in 2 cubes Base 2, 1 cube Booster A, thyme, and the broth. Simmer 3 minutes until the sauce is rich and slightly thick.

steps.title: Smother
steps.text: Nestle the chicken back in, spoon onions over it, and simmer 5 minutes until cooked through (175°F for thighs). Heat the broiler.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Top with Gruyère and broil 2–3 minutes until bubbling and spotted brown.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with toasted baguette slices or mashed potatoes to soak up the gravy.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom Farro "Risotto"
recipes.description: Nutty farro cooked risotto-style with browned mushrooms and finished silky with Velvet Cream. No constant stirring.

steps.title: Brown mushrooms
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wide pot over medium-high. Add the mushrooms in one layer and cook undisturbed 4 minutes, then stir and cook 2 more until browned. Season with salt.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Push the mushrooms aside, add the chicken, and cook 4 minutes until browned on the outside.

steps.title: Toast and simmer
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster A, and the farro; stir 1 minute to coat. Add the hot broth, bring to a boil, then simmer uncovered 20 minutes, stirring every few minutes, until the farro is tender with a little chew.

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: Stir in the beans for the last 5 minutes of simmering.

steps.title: Make it creamy
steps.text: Stir in 2 cubes Base 4 and the spinach until melted, glossy, and the spinach wilts. Loosen with a splash of broth if needed.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Fold in the parmesan, season with salt and pepper, and serve.

recipes.title: One-Pan Greek Lemon Chicken Orzo
recipes.description: Golden chicken thighs baked into lemony orzo with oregano, spinach, and feta. One pan, minimal dishes.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F. Season the thighs with salt and oregano. Sear skin-side down in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high for 7 minutes until the skin is crisp. Flip and remove.

steps.title: Toast orzo
steps.text: Pour off all but 1 tbsp fat. Add the orzo with 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 3, and 1 cube Booster A; stir 1 minute until the orzo is coated and fragrant.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Stir in the broth and lemon zest. Nestle the chicken on top skin-side up and bake 18 minutes until the orzo absorbs the liquid and the chicken reaches 175°F.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir the spinach and lemon juice into the orzo around the chicken until wilted. Crumble feta over the top.

recipes.title: Skillet Shepherd's Pie
recipes.description: Savory minced filling in a red-wine gravy under a fluffy mashed potato lid, baked in the same skillet.

steps.title: Mash
steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water 15 minutes until very tender. Drain and mash with 2 tbsp butter, the milk, and salt.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Meanwhile, brown the meat in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high for 6 minutes. Spoon off excess fat.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Meanwhile, brown the turkey in 1 tbsp oil in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high for 6 minutes until no pink remains.

steps.title: Warm lentils
steps.text: Meanwhile, warm 1 tbsp butter in an oven-safe skillet and add the lentils.

steps.title: Gravy
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, 2 cubes Booster A, and the broth. Simmer 4 minutes until thick, then stir in the frozen vegetables. Heat the broiler.

steps.title: Top and broil
steps.text: Spread the mash over the filling, rough up the surface with a fork, dot with the remaining butter, and broil 4–5 minutes until the peaks are golden.

notes: Freezes beautifully in individual containers.

recipes.title: Pork Chops with Apple-Thyme Pan Sauce
recipes.description: Juicy seared chops with sweet-tart apples and a savory thyme glaze. Fall dinner in 20 minutes.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Pat the chops dry and season both sides well with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high. Sear the chops 4–5 minutes per side until browned and 140°F inside. Rest on a plate.

steps.title: Apples
steps.text: Add the butter and apple wedges; cook 3 minutes until golden at the edges.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster A, the cider, and thyme leaves. Simmer 2 minutes, scraping the pan, until syrupy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Return the chops and resting juices, turn to coat, and serve with the apples spooned over.

recipes.title: Crispy Salmon with Velvet Herb Sauce
recipes.description: Crisp-skinned salmon on a pool of bright green, creamy herb sauce. Faster than takeout.

steps.title: Dry and season
steps.text: Pat the salmon very dry and season with salt. Start the grains if not using leftovers.

steps.title: Crisp the skin
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high. Lay the fillets skin-side down and press gently for 10 seconds. Cook 5–6 minutes until the skin is crisp and the flesh is opaque two-thirds up. Flip and cook 1 minute. Remove.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Add the asparagus to the pan with a splash of water and a pinch of salt; cover and cook 3 minutes until bright and crisp-tender. Remove.

steps.title: Herb sauce
steps.text: Lower heat. Add 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster A, and 2 tbsp water. Stir 60–90 seconds until smooth and pale green. Squeeze in the lemon.

steps.title: Plate
steps.text: Spoon sauce onto plates, add grains and asparagus, and set the salmon on top skin-side up. Garnish with dill.

recipes.title: Garlic Shrimp Scampi Linguine
recipes.description: Plump shrimp in a buttery, garlicky, lemony sauce tossed with linguine. Twelve minutes, start to finish.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.text: Cook the linguine in well-salted boiling water until al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Shrimp
steps.text: Meanwhile, pat the shrimp dry and season with salt. Cook in 1 tbsp butter in a large skillet over medium-high for 1 minute per side until just pink. Remove.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster A, red pepper flakes, and 1/2 cup pasta water. Simmer 1 minute until creamy.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the linguine, remaining butter, lemon juice, and shrimp. Toss over low heat 1 minute until glossy, adding pasta water as needed. Finish with parsley and lemon zest.

recipes.title: 30-Minute Weeknight Bolognese
recipes.description: A deep, meaty ragù that tastes like it simmered all afternoon, thanks to three cubes doing the slow work.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a Dutch oven over medium-high and cook the meat 7 minutes, breaking it up, until browned with crisp bits.

steps.title: Lentil base
steps.text: Warm 2 tbsp olive oil in a Dutch oven; add the lentils with 1 cup water and simmer 5 minutes before continuing.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 2 cubes Base 2, and 1 cube Booster A; stir until melted and coating everything.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the crushed tomatoes and milk. Simmer 15–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and the oil glistens on top. Season with salt.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.text: Cook the pasta until al dente, reserving 1/2 cup water. Toss with the sauce and a splash of pasta water.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Shower with parmesan.

notes: Doubles easily; freeze sauce in 2-cup portions.

recipes.title: Mushroom Pan-Gravy Cutlets
recipes.description: Tender cutlets under a silky mushroom gravy, in the spirit of chicken Marsala, ready for mashed potatoes or noodles.

steps.title: Dredge
steps.text: Season the cutlets with salt and pepper and dredge lightly in flour, shaking off the excess.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Brown in 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high, 2–3 minutes per side, until golden and cooked through. Remove.

steps.title: Mushrooms
steps.text: Add another 1 tbsp oil and the mushrooms; cook 5 minutes until browned and their liquid evaporates.

steps.title: Gravy
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster A, and the broth. Simmer 2 minutes until smooth and thickened.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Return the cutlets to warm through 1 minute, spooning gravy over. Serve over noodles or potatoes with parsley.

recipes.title: 20-Minute Beef Stroganoff
recipes.description: Seared beef strips and mushrooms in a tangy, creamy sauce over buttered egg noodles.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with the butter.

steps.title: Sear beef
steps.text: Season the beef strips with salt. Sear in batches in a very hot skillet with 1 tbsp oil, 1 minute per side. Remove.

steps.title: Brown beef
steps.text: Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high for 6 minutes, breaking it up. Leave it in the pan.

steps.title: Mushrooms
steps.text: Cook the mushrooms in the same pan 5 minutes until browned.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 2 cubes Base 4, 1 cube Booster A, and the broth. Simmer 2 minutes, then remove from heat and stir in the sour cream.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Return any seared beef with its juices. Serve over noodles with herbs.

recipes.title: Provençal Lentils with Sausage
recipes.description: French green lentils simmered with herbs and topped with browned sausages. Rustic, cheap, and deeply satisfying.

steps.title: Simmer lentils
steps.text: In a pot, combine the lentils, broth, herbes de Provence, 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster A. Bring to a boil, then simmer covered 25 minutes until tender but holding shape.

steps.title: Sausages
steps.text: Meanwhile, brown the sausages in a skillet over medium heat, turning, 12–15 minutes until cooked through.

steps.title: Make it hearty
steps.text: For a vegetarian bowl, top each serving with a fried egg or toasted walnuts and a spoon of Dijon.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Stir the vinegar into the lentils and season with salt. They should be loose but not soupy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon into bowls, top with sausages, and scatter parsley. Serve with bread.

recipes.title: Creamy Rosemary White Bean Soup
recipes.description: Velvety, partly blended bean soup with rosemary and garlic. Pantry-only comfort.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: In a pot over medium, melt 2 cubes Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A with the rosemary sprig for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the beans with their liquid and the broth. Simmer 12 minutes. Remove the rosemary stem.

steps.title: Blend half
steps.text: Stir in 1 cube Base 4, then blend about half the soup with an immersion blender so it's creamy but still chunky.

steps.title: Greens
steps.text: Add the kale and simmer 3 minutes.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Stir in the shredded chicken and heat 2 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Brighten with lemon juice and a drizzle of olive oil. Serve with bread.

recipes.title: Greek Meatball Pitas with Herb Yogurt
recipes.description: Juicy oregano-spiked meatballs stuffed into warm pitas with cucumber, tomato, and a green herb yogurt.

steps.title: Herb yogurt
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 (20 seconds in the microwave) and stir into the yogurt with a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Combine the meat, panko, egg, oregano, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1 cube Booster A (softened). Mix gently and roll into 16 small balls.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Brown in 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high, turning, 8–10 minutes until cooked through (165°F).

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add the remaining 1 cube Base 3 with 2 tbsp water and toss the meatballs 1 minute until coated.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Warm the pitas and fill with meatballs, cucumber, tomatoes, and herb yogurt.

recipes.title: Bistro Steak Salad with Warm Dijon Dressing
recipes.description: Seared steak sliced over crisp greens with a warm, mustardy herb dressing made right in the pan.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Season the steak with salt and pepper. Sear in a hot skillet with 1 tsp oil, 4 minutes per side for medium-rare. Rest 5 minutes.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Lower heat to medium. Add 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Booster A, the olive oil, and vinegar to the pan; whisk 60 seconds until emulsified. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Salad
steps.text: Toss the greens, tomatoes, and onion with half the warm dressing.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slice the steak thinly against the grain, lay over the salad, drizzle with the remaining dressing, and top with blue cheese.

recipes.title: Pan-Roasted Chicken Thighs & Herb Potatoes
recipes.description: Crackling-skinned chicken roasted on a bed of potatoes that soak up the herby drippings.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 450°F. Soften 1 cube Base 1 and 2 cubes Booster A (30 seconds in the microwave) and mix with the olive oil.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: On a sheet pan, toss the potatoes with half the herb mixture and a big pinch of salt. Rub the rest under and over the chicken skin; season with salt.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Arrange the chicken skin-up on the potatoes with lemon quarters and herb sprigs. Roast 28–30 minutes until the skin is crisp and the thighs reach 175°F.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Squeeze the roasted lemons over everything and toss the potatoes in the pan juices before serving.

recipes.title: Sausage, Peppers & Onions
recipes.description: The street-fair classic: blistered peppers and sweet onions with browned sausage in a garlicky tomato glaze.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the sausages in a large skillet with 1 tsp oil over medium-high, turning, about 8 minutes. Slice into thick coins and return to the pan.

steps.title: Peppers
steps.text: Add the peppers and onion with a pinch of salt; cook 6 minutes until softened and charred in spots.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster A, and the water. Toss 2 minutes until everything is coated and the sausage is cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile into toasted rolls with provolone, or serve over polenta or pasta.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Eggplant & Chickpea Orzo
recipes.description: Silky browned eggplant and chickpeas folded into tomato orzo with olives and feta.

steps.title: Brown eggplant
steps.text: Heat 3 tbsp olive oil in a deep skillet over medium-high. Add the eggplant and a pinch of salt; cook 8 minutes, turning, until browned and creamy inside.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Add the orzo, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster A; stir 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the broth and chickpeas, bring to a simmer, cover, and cook 10 minutes, stirring once, until the orzo is tender.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Fold in the olives, top with feta and herbs, and drizzle with olive oil.

recipes.title: Puff-Top Turkey Pot Pie Skillet
recipes.description: A creamy, herby filling under a golden puff-pastry lid. The perfect home for leftover turkey or chicken.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: In an oven-safe skillet over medium, melt 2 cubes Base 1, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A. Sprinkle in the flour and stir 1 minute, then whisk in the broth. Simmer 3 minutes until thick.

steps.title: Add
steps.text: Stir in the meat and frozen vegetables; season with salt and pepper. Remove from heat.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Lay the puff pastry over the skillet, trim the overhang, cut a few slits, and brush with beaten egg.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 22–25 minutes until the pastry is puffed and deep golden. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Cod Provençal with Tomatoes & Olives
recipes.description: Tender cod poached in a garlicky tomato, olive, and herb sauce. Light, bright, and ready in 20.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: In a skillet over medium, melt 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster A with the water. Add the tomatoes, olives, and capers; simmer 4 minutes until the tomatoes slump.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Season the fish with salt and nestle into the sauce. Cover and simmer gently 7–9 minutes until it flakes easily.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon sauce over the fish, scatter basil, and drizzle with olive oil. Serve with bread or rice.

recipes.title: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Gnocchi
recipes.description: Crisp pan-fried gnocchi in a blush-pink sun-dried tomato cream with spinach.

steps.title: Crisp gnocchi
steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high. Add the gnocchi straight from the package in one layer; cook 4 minutes per side until golden. Remove.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and cook 5 minutes in the same pan until golden and cooked through.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster A, the sun-dried tomatoes, and 1/3 cup water. Stir 2 minutes until a creamy pink sauce forms.

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: Add the beans and simmer 2 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Add the spinach and gnocchi; toss until the spinach wilts. Top with parmesan.

recipes.title: Weeknight Beef Bourguignon
recipes.description: The red-wine beef stew flavor you love in 45 minutes, using quick-cooking sirloin and two Booster A cubes.

steps.title: Render
steps.text: In a Dutch oven over medium, cook the bacon until crisp. Remove, leaving the fat (or use 1 tbsp oil).

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Pat the beef dry, season well, and sear in batches over high heat, 2 minutes per side. Remove.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Cook the mushrooms, carrots, and pearl onions 5 minutes until browned.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, 2 cubes Booster A, and the flour; stir 1 minute. Whisk in the broth and simmer 15 minutes until the carrots are tender.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Return the beef and bacon; simmer 5 minutes until the beef is medium and the sauce is glossy. Serve over potatoes or with bread.

recipes.title: Pasta e Ceci
recipes.description: Roman chickpea-and-pasta stew: creamy, peppery, rosemary-scented, and made from pantry staples.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: In a pot over medium, melt 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster A with the rosemary and pepper flakes, 2 minutes.

steps.title: Chickpeas
steps.text: Add the chickpeas with their liquid and the broth. Simmer 5 minutes, then mash about a third of the chickpeas against the pot.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.text: Add the pasta and simmer, stirring often, 10–12 minutes until tender and the stew is thick. Add water if it gets too tight.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Remove the rosemary stem. Ladle into bowls, top with pecorino, black pepper, and a good drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Greek Baked Giant Beans (Gigantes)
recipes.description: Creamy butter beans baked in a thick dill-tomato sauce until jammy at the edges. Serve warm or at room temperature.

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Heat the oven to 400°F.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: In an oven-safe skillet over medium, melt 2 cubes Base 2 and 1 cube Booster A with the olive oil. Add the tomatoes and 1/2 cup water; simmer 3 minutes.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Stir in the beans and most of the dill. Bake uncovered 30 minutes until the sauce is thick and the top beans are blistered.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Crumble feta and remaining dill over the top. Serve with bread.

recipes.title: Lemon-Herb Cutlets with Smashed Potatoes
recipes.description: Crispy smashed potatoes and quick-seared cutlets, both glossed with a bright green lemon-herb sauce.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Boil the whole potatoes in salted water 15 minutes until tender. Drain and let steam-dry.

steps.title: Smash
steps.text: Smash each potato flat with a mug. Fry in 2 tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high, 4 minutes per side, until crisp. Salt and remove.

steps.title: Cutlets
steps.text: Season the cutlets and cook in the remaining oil, 2–3 minutes per side, until cooked through.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Lower heat; add 2 cubes Base 3, 1 cube Booster A, lemon juice, and 2 tbsp water. Stir 60 seconds until glossy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the green sauce over the cutlets and potatoes; finish with parmesan and lemon zest.

recipes.title: Pork Medallions in Mustard Cream
recipes.description: Tender pork tenderloin coins in a classic Dijon cream sauce. Elegant but painless.

steps.title: Flatten
steps.text: Press each medallion to 3/4 inch with your palm; season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high, 3 minutes per side, until browned and just cooked (145°F pork, 165°F chicken). Remove.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add the broth, scraping the pan. Stir in 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster A, and both mustards; simmer 2 minutes until creamy.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Return the meat and juices; turn to coat. Serve over noodles or potatoes with herbs.

recipes.title: Bistro Garlic Mussels
recipes.description: Mussels steamed open in a creamy garlic-herb broth with plenty of bread for dunking.

steps.title: Clean
steps.text: Discard any mussels that are cracked or stay open when tapped.

steps.title: Broth
steps.text: In a wide pot over medium-high, melt 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A with the wine. Bring to a strong simmer.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Add the mussels, cover tightly, and steam 5–6 minutes, shaking the pot once, until they open. Discard any that stay closed.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Swirl in the butter and parsley. Serve in bowls with all the broth and plenty of baguette.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Tortellini Soup
recipes.description: A blush tomato soup loaded with cheese tortellini. Grilled-cheese energy in a single bowl.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: In a pot over medium, melt 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster A for 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the tomatoes and broth; simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Stir in 1 cube Base 4 until smooth and blush-colored.

steps.title: Tortellini
steps.text: Add the tortellini and the chicken or beans; simmer 4–5 minutes until the pasta is tender.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the spinach to wilt. Serve topped with parmesan and black pepper.

recipes.title: Bistro Potato Hash with Fried Eggs
recipes.description: Crispy herbed potatoes and onions crowned with runny fried eggs. Add sausage for a heartier plate.

steps.title: Par-cook
steps.text: Microwave the diced potatoes covered with 2 tbsp water for 4 minutes. Drain.

steps.title: Sausage
steps.text: Brown the sausage in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high, 4 minutes, breaking it up. Remove, leaving the fat.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Add the oil and potatoes to the skillet in one layer. Cook 6 minutes undisturbed, then toss and cook 3 more until crisp. Season with salt.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A; toss 1 minute until the potatoes are glossy and fragrant. Return any sausage.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Make 4 wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 3 minutes until the whites set. Top with chives.

recipes.title: French Herb & Gruyère Omelette
recipes.description: A tender, pale-gold omelette rolled around Gruyère and a ribbon of green herb sauce. Five minutes flat.

steps.title: Herb sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A for 20 seconds until loose; stir smooth.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt until no streaks remain.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Melt the butter in a nonstick pan over medium-low. Add the eggs and stir constantly with a spatula while shaking the pan for 60–90 seconds, until small soft curds form but the top is still wet.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spread the curds flat, sprinkle with Gruyère, and spoon half the herb sauce down the center. Roll into thirds and slide onto a plate seam-side down.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Brush the remaining herb sauce on top. Serve with toast.

recipes.title: Croque Madame Toasts
recipes.description: Open-faced ham and Gruyère toasts under a creamy garlic béchamel, each topped with a sunny egg.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster A for 20–30 seconds; stir in the Dijon. This is your instant béchamel.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Heat the broiler. Toast the bread lightly, spread with half the sauce, layer ham, the rest of the sauce, and the Gruyère.

steps.title: Broil
steps.text: Broil 3–4 minutes until bubbly and browned.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Meanwhile fry the eggs sunny-side up in a little butter. Slide one onto each toast.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Feta Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs gently poached in a peppery tomato sauce, finished with salty feta and herbs. Breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

steps.title: Peppers
steps.text: Soften the bell pepper in 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium, 4 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 2 cubes Base 2, 1 cube Booster A, the paprika, and tomatoes. Simmer 5 minutes until thickened.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Make 6 wells, crack an egg into each, and season with salt. Cover and simmer 5–6 minutes until the whites are set but yolks are runny.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Scatter feta and herbs. Serve from the pan with bread.

recipes.title: Sage Turkey Breakfast Patties
recipes.description: Juicy homemade breakfast sausage patties with sage and black pepper. Make a batch and freeze.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A (20 seconds in the microwave). Mix into the meat with the sage, maple, 3/4 tsp salt, and 1/2 tsp pepper.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Form 8 thin patties about 3 inches wide.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook in 1 tbsp oil over medium heat, 4–5 minutes per side, until browned and 165°F inside.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve on toasted English muffins with a fried egg.

notes: Freeze cooked patties between parchment; reheat 60 seconds in the microwave.

recipes.title: Garlic Mushroom Toast with Jammy Eggs
recipes.description: Creamy garlic mushrooms piled on toast with soft-boiled eggs. Café brunch in ten minutes.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook 6 1/2 minutes, then into cold water.

steps.title: Mushrooms
steps.text: Meanwhile, sear the mushrooms in the butter over high heat 4 minutes until browned. Season with salt.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster A, and 1 tbsp water; toss 1 minute until creamy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Toast the bread, pile on the mushrooms, and top with halved peeled eggs and parsley.

recipes.title: Spinach & Feta Egg Wraps
recipes.description: Soft scrambled eggs with wilted spinach and feta rolled into a toasted tortilla. Freezer-friendly.

steps.title: Greens
steps.text: In a nonstick skillet over medium, melt 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A for 30 seconds. Add the spinach and cook until wilted.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken and warm through, 1 minute.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Pour in the beaten eggs and gently scramble 2 minutes until just set. Fold in the feta.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Divide between tortillas, roll tightly, and toast seam-side down in the dry pan 1 minute per side.

recipes.title: Sausage & Herb Breakfast Strata
recipes.description: An overnight-style savory bread pudding with sausage, cheese, and herbs. Assemble the night before, bake in the morning.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the sausage in a skillet over medium-high, 6 minutes. Add the spinach to wilt.

steps.title: Custard
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A for 30 seconds; whisk with the eggs, milk, and 1/2 tsp salt until smooth.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Layer bread, sausage mixture, and cheese in a greased 9x13 dish. Pour the custard over and press down so the bread soaks. Rest 15 minutes (or refrigerate overnight).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 350°F for 40–45 minutes until puffed, golden, and set in the center.

recipes.title: Steak & Eggs with Peppercorn Butter
recipes.description: A diner classic: seared steak, crispy-edged eggs, and a quick peppercorn-herb butter sauce.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Season the steak generously and sear in a hot skillet 4 minutes per side. Rest.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: In the same pan over medium, fry the eggs in the butter until the edges crisp.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Off the heat, add 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster A, the pepper, and 1 tbsp water; swirl until creamy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slice the steak, plate with eggs and toast, and spoon the peppercorn sauce over.

recipes.title: Warm Chicken Caesar Wraps
recipes.description: Seared chicken tossed in a creamy garlic-Dijon Caesar dressing and wrapped with crunchy romaine and parmesan.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Season the meat with salt and pepper and cook in 1 tsp oil over medium-high, 3 minutes per side.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster A for 20 seconds; whisk with the lemon juice and 1 tbsp water.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the romaine and parmesan with half the dressing and the meat with the rest.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Fill the tortillas, roll tightly, and slice in half.

recipes.title: Tuscan Tuna & White Bean Salad
recipes.description: Good olive-oil tuna, creamy white beans, and red onion in a lemony herb dressing. No cooking.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A in a bowl (30 seconds in the microwave). Whisk in the lemon juice and olive oil.

steps.title: Soften onion
steps.text: Toss the red onion in the dressing and let it sit 2 minutes to mellow.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the beans and flaked tuna; fold gently.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile onto arugula, or onto toasted bread.

recipes.title: Turkey Dijon Melt
recipes.description: Griddled sourdough stuffed with turkey, Swiss, and a savory onion-Dijon spread.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster A for 20 seconds; stir in the Dijon.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread the onion-Dijon mix on 2 bread slices, add turkey and Swiss, and close. Butter the outsides.

steps.title: Griddle
steps.text: Cook in a skillet over medium-low 3 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and the cheese melts.

recipes.title: Warm French Lentil Salad with Soft Eggs
recipes.description: Precooked lentils dressed warm in a mustardy herb vinaigrette, topped with jammy eggs.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Boil the eggs 6 1/2 minutes, then cool in cold water and peel.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Meanwhile, in a skillet over medium, melt 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A with the olive oil, shallot, and vinegar for 1 minute.

steps.title: Lentils
steps.text: Add the lentils and toss 2 minutes until warm and glossy. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile onto arugula and top with halved eggs.

recipes.title: Herby Chickpea Smash Sandwich
recipes.description: A creamy, tangy chickpea "salad" with celery crunch, piled on toasted bread. Like tuna salad, but plant-based.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster A for 20 seconds until creamy.

steps.title: Smash
steps.text: Mash the chickpeas with a fork until mostly broken. Fold in the dressing, celery, capers, and lemon juice. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Pile onto toast with lettuce.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Steak Bites
recipes.description: Seared sirloin cubes tossed in garlicky herb butter. A snack, an appetizer, or dinner with potatoes.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Pat the beef dry and season with salt. Sear in a ripping-hot skillet with 1 tbsp oil in one layer, 2 minutes per side, in batches if needed.

steps.title: Butter
steps.text: Lower heat to medium. Add the butter, 1 cube Base 1, and 1 cube Booster A; toss 60 seconds until the beef is glazed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Scatter parsley and serve with toothpicks or over potatoes.

recipes.title: Souvlaki Skewers with Tzatziki
recipes.description: Lemon-oregano marinated skewers seared until charred, with cool green tzatziki and warm pitas.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A; mix with lemon juice, oregano, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp oil. Toss with the meat and let sit 10 minutes.

steps.title: Tzatziki
steps.text: Thaw the remaining 1 cube Base 3 and stir into the yogurt with the cucumber and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Skewer and cook
steps.text: Thread onto skewers. Grill or sear in a grill pan over high heat, turning, 10–12 minutes until charred and cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with warm pitas and tzatziki.

recipes.title: Lemon Orzo Salad with Chickpeas & Feta
recipes.description: A bright, herby orzo salad that gets better by day two. The ultimate meal-prep lunch.

steps.title: Orzo
steps.text: Cook the orzo in salted water 9 minutes; drain and rinse under cold water.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A; whisk with lemon juice, zest, and olive oil.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the orzo with the dressing, vegetables, and protein. Fold in feta.

notes: Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken & Wild Rice Soup
recipes.description: A cozy, Midwestern-style creamy soup with nutty wild rice and tender chicken.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: In a pot, melt 2 cubes Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A. Add the carrots, mushrooms, rice, and broth. Bring to a boil.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Nestle the whole chicken thighs into the pot.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Simmer covered 20–25 minutes until the rice is tender.

steps.title: Shred
steps.text: Remove the chicken, shred with two forks, and return it to the pot.

steps.title: Turkey
steps.text: Stir in the shredded turkey and heat 3 minutes.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Stir in 1 cube Base 4 until the soup is creamy. Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Lemony Pantry Tuna Spaghetti
recipes.description: A pantry rescue dinner: spaghetti tossed with olive-oil tuna, lemon, capers, and garlic.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Cook the spaghetti until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup water.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: In a skillet over medium, melt 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A with the oil from the tuna and the capers, 1 minute.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the pasta, flaked tuna, lemon juice and zest, and a splash of pasta water. Toss until glossy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with breadcrumbs and parsley.

recipes.title: Niçoise Salad Plates
recipes.description: Potatoes, green beans, jammy eggs, and tuna (or seared salmon) with a mustardy herb vinaigrette.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Boil the potatoes in salted water 8 minutes. Add the eggs and cook 7 minutes more, adding the green beans for the final 2 minutes. Drain and cool under cold water.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A; whisk with the olive oil and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Arrange lettuce, potatoes, green beans, halved eggs, tuna, and olives on plates. Drizzle generously with dressing.

recipes.title: Garlic-Herb White Bean Dip
recipes.description: A silky, garlicky white bean dip that's ready in five minutes. Serve with crudités or pita chips.

steps.title: Soften
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster A for 20 seconds.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend with the beans, lemon juice, olive oil, and 2 tbsp bean liquid until very smooth. Season with salt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Swirl into a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and serve with chips or vegetables.

recipes.title: Crispy Herb-Roasted Chickpeas
recipes.description: Crunchy, garlicky, herb-dusted chickpeas. A high-protein snack that beats chips.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Rub the chickpeas dry in a towel and pop off any loose skins.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Toss with olive oil and salt on a sheet pan. Roast 20 minutes, shaking once, until crisp.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A (30 seconds); toss with the hot chickpeas and roast 5 minutes more until dry and fragrant.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool on the pan. They crisp further as they cool.

recipes.title: Bistro Egg Salad Toasts
recipes.description: Creamy, chive-flecked egg salad with a Dijon kick on crisp toast.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, cool in ice water, and peel.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster A for 20 seconds; stir in the Dijon.

steps.title: Mash
steps.text: Chop the eggs and fold into the dressing with chives, salt, and pepper.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spread onto toast and cut into fingers.

recipes.title: Herbed Turkey Meatball Bites
recipes.description: Bite-size baked meatballs with a savory herb glaze. Great for snack boxes and lunchboxes.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Soften 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A; mix into the meat with the panko, egg, parmesan, and 1/2 tsp salt.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Roll into 24 bite-size balls and space on a lined sheet pan.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 12–15 minutes until browned and 165°F inside.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with toothpicks and mustard, or pack for lunches.

recipes.title: White Bean & Tomato Bruschetta
recipes.description: Garlicky toasts piled with warm white beans in a rich tomato-herb glaze.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Brush the baguette slices with olive oil and toast until golden.

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: In a skillet over medium, melt 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster A. Add the beans and toss 2 minutes until glazed, lightly crushing a few.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon onto toasts and top with basil and flaky salt.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Cucumber Bites
recipes.description: Cool cucumber rounds topped with herbed cream and silky smoked salmon. Party-ready.

steps.title: Herb cream
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A (20 seconds); stir smooth with a squeeze of lemon.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Dollop the cream on cucumber rounds and top each with a fold of salmon.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.text: Finish with dill and black pepper.

recipes.title: Steak Crostini with Horseradish Cream
recipes.description: Rosy slices of seared steak on crisp toasts with a punchy horseradish cream.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Season the steak and sear 4 minutes per side. Rest 10 minutes, then slice very thin.

steps.title: Crostini
steps.text: Brush the bread with oil and toast until crisp.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster A (20 seconds) and stir in the horseradish.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Top each toast with arugula, steak, and a dot of horseradish cream.

recipes.title: Chicken Florentine Pasta
recipes.description: Penne and golden chicken in a garlicky spinach cream sauce. Comfort food without the heaviness.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.text: Cook the penne until al dente, reserving 1 cup water.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Season the chicken and cook in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high, 6 minutes, until golden and cooked through.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 2 cubes Base 4, 1 cube Booster A, and 1/2 cup pasta water; stir until creamy.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the spinach and pasta; toss until wilted and glossy. Finish with parmesan.

recipes.title: Seared Scallops with Herb Cream
recipes.description: Golden-crusted scallops on a bright green herb cream with lemony rice. Restaurant-level in 13 minutes.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Pat the scallops very dry and season with salt.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a skillet over high until smoking. Sear the scallops 2 minutes without moving until deeply golden, flip, add the butter, and cook 1 minute. Remove.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Off heat, add 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster A, and 2 tbsp water; swirl until smooth. Add lemon juice.

steps.title: Plate
steps.text: Spoon sauce onto plates with rice and top with scallops.

recipes.title: Lemony Lentil & Spinach Soup
recipes.description: A golden red-lentil soup with spinach and lots of lemon. Light, cheap, and deeply savory.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: In a pot, melt 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A with the cumin. Add the lentils and broth; simmer 20 minutes until the lentils collapse.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Partly blend for a creamy texture.

steps.title: Green
steps.text: Stir in 1 cube Base 3 and the spinach until wilted. Add lemon juice to taste.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drizzle with olive oil and serve with warm pita.

recipes.title: Takeout-Style Beef & Broccoli
recipes.description: Tender velveted beef and crisp-bright broccoli in a glossy savory-sweet sauce. Better than delivery.

steps.title: Velvet
steps.text: Toss the beef with the cornstarch, 1 tsp soy sauce, and 1 tsp oil. Let sit while you prep.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Toss the tofu with the cornstarch and fry in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high, turning, 8 minutes until crisp. Remove.

steps.title: Broccoli
steps.text: Add the broccoli and 3 tbsp water to a hot wok; cover and steam 2 minutes until bright green. Remove.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil until smoking. Sear the beef in one layer, 1 minute per side.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 2 cubes Booster B, the oyster sauce, remaining soy, and 1/4 cup water; bubble 1 minute until glossy.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Return the broccoli (and tofu); toss to coat. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Ginger-Scallion Lo Mein
recipes.description: Springy noodles tossed with crisp vegetables in a savory ginger-scallion sauce. Clean-out-the-fridge friendly.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Cook the noodles, drain, and toss with 1 tsp sesame oil.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Stir-fry the protein in 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat, 4–5 minutes, until browned. Remove.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Stir-fry the vegetables 2 minutes until crisp-tender.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 2 cubes Booster B, soy sauce, and 2 tbsp water; let it bubble 30 seconds.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the noodles, protein, and scallions; toss over high heat 1 minute until glossy.

recipes.title: Weeknight Mapo Tofu
recipes.description: Silky tofu in a fiery, savory, numbing sauce with a little ground meat. Sichuan comfort over rice.

steps.title: Blanch
steps.text: Slide the tofu into gently simmering salted water for 2 minutes to firm it. Drain.

steps.title: Pork
steps.text: Brown the pork in 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat, 3 minutes, until crisp.

steps.title: Mushroom option
steps.text: For a vegetarian version, brown 4 oz finely chopped shiitakes in 1 tbsp oil until crisp.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Lower to medium. Add the doubanjiang, 1 cube Base 2, and 2 cubes Booster B; fry 1 minute until the oil turns red. Add 3/4 cup water.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the tofu and simmer gently 4 minutes, nudging (not stirring) to keep it whole. Stir in the cornstarch slurry until glossy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with Sichuan pepper and sliced scallions; serve over rice.

recipes.title: Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.description: Juicy chicken, crunchy peanuts, and blistered dried chilies in a tangy, glossy sauce.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Toss the protein with cornstarch and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Stir-fry in 2 tbsp oil over high heat 5 minutes until browned (8 minutes for tofu). Remove.

steps.title: Chilies
steps.text: Add the dried chilies and bell pepper; stir-fry 1 minute until the chilies darken.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster B, vinegar, soy, and 2 tbsp water; bubble until glossy.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Return the protein with the peanuts and toss 30 seconds. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowls
recipes.description: Sticky homemade teriyaki-glazed salmon over rice with cucumber, avocado, and sesame.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Season the salmon cubes lightly and sear in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high, 2 minutes per side.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster B, soy sauce, and honey. Gently toss 1–2 minutes until the sauce reduces into a sticky glaze.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Divide rice into bowls, top with salmon, cucumber, and avocado, and sprinkle with sesame.

recipes.title: Cold Sesame Noodles
recipes.description: Chewy noodles in a creamy, nutty sesame-ginger dressing with crunchy cucumber. Perfect lunchbox noodles.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Cook the noodles, then rinse under cold water until chilled. Drain well.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster B for 20 seconds; whisk with tahini, soy, vinegar, and chili oil until smooth.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the noodles with the dressing, then top with cucumber and protein.

notes: Keeps 3 days refrigerated — loosen with a splash of water before eating.

recipes.title: Gochujang Ground Beef Bowls
recipes.description: Sweet-spicy Korean-style ground meat over rice with quick-pickled veggies and a fried egg.

steps.title: Pickle
steps.text: Toss the cucumber with the vinegar and a pinch of salt and sugar.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the meat in a skillet over high heat, 6 minutes, until crispy in spots.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster B, gochujang, soy, and brown sugar; toss 2 minutes until sticky.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over rice with pickles and a fried egg.

recipes.title: 10-Minute Egg Fried Rice
recipes.description: Day-old rice, fluffy eggs, and peas wok-tossed with ginger and scallion. The best use of leftovers.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over high heat. Scramble the eggs until just set; remove.

steps.title: Pork
steps.text: Stir-fry the ham 1 minute until browned at the edges.

steps.title: Shrimp
steps.text: Stir-fry the shrimp 2 minutes until pink.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Add 1 tbsp oil, the rice, and the peas; stir-fry 3 minutes, pressing out clumps, until hot and slightly toasty.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, and the soy; toss 1 minute. Fold the eggs back in and finish with scallions.

recipes.title: Miso-Butter Cod with Bok Choy
recipes.description: Flaky cod in a silky miso-butter cream with tender baby bok choy. Elegant and fast.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: In a skillet over medium, melt 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster B with the miso, butter, and 1/4 cup water until smooth.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Lay the bok choy cut-side down and the seasoned cod on top. Cover and simmer gently 8–10 minutes until the cod flakes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the sauce over and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Ginger Chicken Congee
recipes.description: Silky, savory rice porridge with poached chicken and crispy toppings. The ultimate cozy breakfast.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Rinse the rice. In a pot, combine rice, broth, 2 cubes Base 1, and 1 cube Booster B. Bring to a boil, then simmer partially covered 40–45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the grains break down and it's creamy.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Add the chicken for the last 20 minutes. Remove, shred, and return to the pot.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Soft-boil the eggs 7 minutes, peel, and halve.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Season with salt and a little soy. It should be thick but pourable; add water as needed.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Serve topped with scallions, fried shallots, and a drizzle of sesame oil.

recipes.title: Wonton Soup with Greens
recipes.description: Frozen dumplings in a fragrant ginger broth with bok choy. A ten-minute bowl of comfort.

steps.title: Broth
steps.text: In a pot, bring the broth to a simmer with 2 cubes Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, and the soy.

steps.title: Dumplings
steps.text: Add the wontons and simmer 5–6 minutes until they float and are hot through.

steps.title: Greens
steps.text: Add the bok choy for the last 2 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle into bowls and top with scallions, sesame oil, and chili oil if you like.

recipes.title: Honey Sesame Chicken
recipes.description: Crispy-edged chicken bites in a sticky honey-soy-sesame glaze. A family takeout favorite.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Toss the protein with cornstarch and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Pan-fry in 3 tbsp oil over medium-high, in batches, 6–8 minutes until crisp and cooked through. Drain.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Wipe the pan. Melt 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster B with the honey and soy; bubble 1 minute until syrupy.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the crispy protein in the glaze, sprinkle with sesame, and serve with rice and broccoli.

recipes.title: Char Siu-Style Pork Tenderloin
recipes.description: Sticky, ruby-glazed roast pork tenderloin, sliced over rice or tucked into steamed buns.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Microwave 1 cube Base 2 and 2 cubes Booster B for 30 seconds; mix with hoisin, honey, and five-spice. Reserve a third.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Season the pork with salt, rub with the glaze, and set on a foil-lined sheet pan.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Roast 20–25 minutes, basting halfway, until 145°F. Brush with reserved glaze and broil 2 minutes to char the edges.

steps.title: Rest and slice
steps.text: Rest 5 minutes, slice thin, and serve over rice or in buns.

recipes.title: Japchae Glass Noodle Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Chewy sweet-potato glass noodles stir-fried with vegetables, beef, and sesame. Korean party noodles made easy.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Boil the noodles 6 minutes, drain, rinse, and snip into shorter lengths.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Stir-fry the protein in 1 tbsp oil over high, 3 minutes. Remove.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Stir-fry the carrot and mushrooms 2 minutes, then add the spinach to wilt.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, soy, and sugar; let it melt.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the noodles and protein; toss 2 minutes until glossy. Finish with sesame oil and seeds.

recipes.title: Chinese Tomato & Egg Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Fluffy eggs folded into sweet-savory, juicy tomatoes. A beloved home-style dish in under ten minutes.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt. Scramble in 1 tbsp oil over high heat until large soft curds form. Remove.

steps.title: Tomatoes
