steps.text: Add the tomatoes and cook 2 minutes until they start releasing juice.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster B, the sugar, and 2 tbsp water; simmer 1 minute until saucy.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Return the eggs, fold gently, and top with scallions. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Creamy Miso Sesame Udon
recipes.description: Thick, chewy udon in a rich miso-sesame cream with mushrooms and greens.

steps.title: Udon
steps.text: Boil the udon 2 minutes to loosen; drain, reserving 1/2 cup water.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Sear the protein and mushrooms in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high, 5 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster B, miso, and 1/3 cup udon water; stir until creamy.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the udon and spinach; toss until coated and the spinach wilts.

recipes.title: Ginger-Scallion Steamed Fish
recipes.description: Delicate white fish steamed and finished with sizzling ginger-scallion oil and soy. Clean and elegant.

ingredients.item: white fish fillets (cod, halibut, sea bass)

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Place the fish on a heatproof plate. Spread 1 cube Base 1 (softened) over the top.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Set the plate over simmering water in a covered wok or pot. Steam 8–10 minutes until opaque and flaky.

steps.title: Sizzle
steps.text: Drain off excess liquid. Top with the ginger and scallions. Heat the oil with 1 cube Booster B until shimmering and pour over the fish so it sizzles. Drizzle with soy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve immediately with rice.

recipes.title: 15-Minute Ginger Ramen with Jammy Eggs
recipes.description: Rich, savory ramen broth built from cubes, with springy noodles and soy-marinated soft eggs.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Boil the eggs 6 1/2 minutes, chill in ice water, peel, and soak in the soy with 1 tbsp water.

steps.title: Broth
steps.text: Bring the broth to a simmer with 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster B, 5 minutes.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Cook the noodles in the broth 3 minutes.

steps.title: Eggs only
steps.text: Use 2 extra eggs for a protein-rich bowl.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Divide into bowls with the meat, halved eggs, scallions, and nori.

recipes.title: Cabbage Pancake (Okonomiyaki-Style)
recipes.description: A savory Japanese-style cabbage pancake with crispy edges, drizzled with tangy sauce and creamy mayo.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B for 20 seconds; whisk with the eggs, flour, 1/4 cup water, and a pinch of salt. Fold in the cabbage.

steps.title: Shrimp
steps.text: Fold the chopped shrimp into the batter.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a nonstick skillet over medium. Spread the batter into a thick round 8 inches wide.

steps.title: Pork
steps.text: Lay the bacon strips on top of the pancake.

steps.title: Flip
steps.text: Cook 5–6 minutes until golden, flip with a plate, and cook 5 more until cooked through.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Drizzle with okonomiyaki sauce and mayo in a crosshatch.

recipes.title: Japanese-Style Curry Rice
recipes.description: Mild, glossy, slightly sweet curry with potatoes and carrots over rice. A Japanese home-cooking staple.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the protein in 1 tbsp oil in a pot over medium-high, 4 minutes.

steps.title: Roux
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster B, 1 cube Booster C, and the flour; stir 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Whisk in the broth, then add the potatoes, carrots, and grated apple. Simmer covered 20 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the sauce is thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season with salt and a splash of soy. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Yakitori Chicken Skewers
recipes.description: Charred chicken-and-scallion skewers brushed with a sweet-salty tare glaze.

steps.title: Tare
steps.text: Simmer 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster B, soy, mirin, and sugar in a small pan 3 minutes until syrupy.

steps.title: Skewer
steps.text: Thread chicken and scallion pieces alternately onto skewers; season with salt.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Grill or broil on high, turning, 8–10 minutes until charred and cooked through, brushing with tare during the last 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Brush once more and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Garlic-Ginger Edamame
recipes.description: Steamed edamame pods tossed in a sizzling garlic, ginger, and chili glaze. Addictive snacking.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Boil or microwave the edamame 4 minutes until hot. Drain well.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: In a skillet over medium-high, melt 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B with the chili flakes for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the edamame in the glaze until coated and sprinkle with flaky salt.

recipes.title: Smashed Cucumber & Silken Tofu Salad
recipes.description: Cool, garlicky smashed cucumbers spooned over silky chilled tofu. A refreshing no-cook snack or light lunch.

steps.title: Smash
steps.text: Smash the cucumbers with the side of a knife and cut into bite-size pieces. Salt and let sit 5 minutes; drain.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster B; whisk with the vinegar.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Slide the tofu onto a plate, top with dressed cucumbers, chili crisp, and sesame.

recipes.title: Dan Dan Noodles
recipes.description: Springy noodles in a nutty, spicy, numbing sauce topped with crispy savory minced meat.

steps.title: Crispy meat
steps.text: Fry the meat in 1 tbsp oil over high heat, 6 minutes, until browned and crisp. Stir in 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster B and fry 1 minute more.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 for 20 seconds; whisk with the tahini, chili oil, soy, and 3 tbsp hot water. Divide between bowls.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Cook the noodles, adding the bok choy for the last minute. Drain.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Pile noodles and greens onto the sauce, top with crispy meat, and toss at the table.

recipes.title: Kimchi Fried Rice with Fried Egg
recipes.description: Tangy, spicy kimchi fried into rice and crowned with a runny fried egg. Great any time of day.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Fry the diced pork in a skillet over medium-high, 3 minutes, until crisp.

steps.title: Kimchi
steps.text: Add the kimchi, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster B; fry 2 minutes.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Add the rice, kimchi juice, and gochujang; stir-fry 3 minutes until hot and lightly crisped.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs sunny-side up in a separate pan.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top the rice with eggs, scallions, and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Crunchy Sesame-Ginger Chicken Salad
recipes.description: Shredded cabbage, carrots, and seared chicken in a punchy sesame-ginger dressing with crunchy toppings.

steps.title: Cook chicken
steps.text: Season and sear the chicken 4 minutes per side. Rest, then slice.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster B; whisk with vinegar and sesame oil.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the cabbage, carrot, and cilantro with dressing.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Top with the protein and peanuts.

recipes.title: Shrimp & Snow Pea Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Plump shrimp and crisp snow peas in a light, gingery garlic sauce. Dinner in 15 minutes.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Toss the protein with cornstarch and a pinch of salt; stir-fry in 1 tbsp oil over high 2 minutes (4 for chicken). Remove.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Stir-fry the snow peas and pepper 2 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, soy, and 3 tbsp water; bubble 30 seconds.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Return the protein, toss to glaze, and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Spicy Korean-Style Pork Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Thin-sliced pork in a fiery, sweet gochujang glaze with onions, eaten with rice and lettuce.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 2 and 2 cubes Booster B for 20 seconds; mix with gochujang, gochugaru, and sugar. Toss with the meat.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Heat a skillet over high. Add the meat and onion in one layer and cook 6–8 minutes, tossing occasionally, until caramelized and cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with rice and lettuce leaves for wrapping.

recipes.title: Rolled Japanese Omelette (Tamagoyaki-Style)
recipes.description: A sweet-savory layered omelette with a hint of ginger and soy. Slice for bento, breakfast, or snacks.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B for 15 seconds; whisk with the eggs, sugar, soy, and 1 tbsp water. Strain for a silkier result.

steps.title: First layer
steps.text: Oil a nonstick pan over medium-low. Pour in a thin layer, let it barely set, and roll it to one side.

steps.title: Layers
steps.text: Add another thin layer, lifting the roll so egg flows underneath; when set, roll back over. Repeat until all the egg is used.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Press the roll in a towel 2 minutes to set, then slice into thick pieces.

recipes.title: Miso Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.description: A creamy-savory miso broth with tender chicken, ramen noodles, and spinach. Cold-weather lunch.

steps.title: Broth
steps.text: Simmer the broth with 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Add the chicken and simmer 12 minutes until cooked. Remove, shred, and return.

steps.title: Tofu
steps.text: Add the tofu and simmer 3 minutes.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Add the noodles and cook according to the package.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Off the heat, whisk the miso with 1 cube Base 4 and a ladle of broth, then stir back in with the spinach.

recipes.title: Fiery Thai Green Curry
recipes.description: A fragrant, spicy coconut curry with crisp vegetables and Thai basil, built on Green Citrus and Velvet Cream cubes.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.text: In a deep skillet over medium-high, fry the curry paste with 1/4 cup of the thick coconut cream from the top of the can for 2 minutes until fragrant and the oil separates.

steps.title: Cubes
steps.text: Add 2 cubes Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster B; stir until melted. Add the rest of the coconut milk and the fish sauce.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken and simmer 8 minutes.

steps.title: Tofu
steps.text: Add the tofu and simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Add the vegetables and simmer 3 minutes until crisp-tender.

steps.title: Shrimp
steps.text: Add the shrimp with the vegetables; simmer 3 minutes until pink.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the basil and season with more fish sauce or a pinch of sugar. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Red Curry Coconut Noodles
recipes.description: Rice noodles tossed in a rich, red, coconut curry sauce with chicken or shrimp and lime.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Soak or boil the rice noodles per the package. Drain.

steps.title: Paste
steps.text: Fry the curry paste in 1 tbsp oil over medium 1 minute. Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster B, and the coconut milk; simmer 2 minutes.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Add the protein and bell pepper and simmer 4–5 minutes until cooked.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the noodles and toss to coat. Finish with lime juice and cilantro.

recipes.title: Tom Kha Coconut Soup
recipes.description: Silky, tangy coconut soup scented with lemongrass and galangal, with mushrooms and tender protein.

steps.title: Broth
steps.text: In a pot, bring the broth, 1 cube Base 1, and 2 cubes Booster B to a simmer for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Coconut
steps.text: Add the coconut milk, 1 cube Base 4, and the mushrooms; simmer 3 minutes. Don't boil hard or the coconut can split.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Add the protein and simmer gently until cooked: 5 minutes for chicken, 3 for shrimp or tofu.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Off the heat, add the fish sauce and lime juice. It should be sour, salty, and rich.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle into bowls with cilantro and chili oil.

recipes.title: Weeknight Pad Thai
recipes.description: Chewy rice noodles in a sweet-sour-savory tamarind sauce with egg, bean sprouts, and crushed peanuts.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Soak the noodles in hot tap water 10 minutes until pliable but firm. Drain.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster B for 20 seconds; whisk with tamarind, fish sauce, and sugar.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Stir-fry the protein in 1 tbsp oil over high heat until cooked. Push aside.

steps.title: Extra egg
steps.text: For an egg-only Pad Thai, use 4 eggs and scramble half here.

steps.title: Egg
steps.text: Crack in the eggs and scramble until just set.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Add the noodles and sauce; toss 2–3 minutes until absorbed and the noodles are tender. Add a splash of water if they stick.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Toss in sprouts. Serve with peanuts and lime wedges.

recipes.title: Thai Basil Stir-Fry (Pad Kra Pao)
recipes.description: Spicy, garlicky minced meat with holy basil over rice, topped with a crispy fried egg. Thailand's favorite lunch.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs in 2 tbsp very hot oil, basting, until the edges are lacy and crisp. Remove.

steps.title: Meat
steps.text: In the same pan over high heat, stir-fry the meat and chilies 4 minutes until browned.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 2 cubes Booster B, oyster sauce, fish sauce, and 2 tbsp water; toss 1 minute.

steps.title: Basil
steps.text: Stir in the basil until just wilted.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over rice topped with the fried eggs.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Banh Mi
recipes.description: Crusty baguettes stuffed with caramelized lemongrass meat, quick-pickled carrots, cucumber, cilantro, and spicy mayo.

steps.title: Pickle
steps.text: Toss the carrots with vinegar, sugar, and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster B; toss with the protein and 1 tsp sugar.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Cook in 1 tbsp oil over high heat, 3 minutes per side, until caramelized.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Mix the mayo and sriracha. Split the rolls, spread with spicy mayo, and fill with protein, pickles, cucumber, and cilantro.

recipes.title: 30-Minute Chicken Pho
recipes.description: A clear, aromatic star-anise broth with rice noodles, tender chicken, and a pile of fresh herbs.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast the star anise and cinnamon in a dry pot 1 minute.

steps.title: Broth
steps.text: Add the broth, 2 cubes Base 1, and 2 cubes Booster B; simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Add the chicken for the last 12 minutes; remove and slice.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Cook the noodles separately and divide between bowls.

steps.title: Beef
steps.text: Lay the raw beef slices over the noodles — the hot broth will cook them.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Strain the broth, add fish sauce, and ladle over the noodles. Serve with sprouts, herbs, and lime.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Caramel-Ginger Salmon
recipes.description: Salmon simmered in a dark, sticky, sweet-salty caramel with ginger and black pepper.

steps.title: Caramel
steps.text: In a skillet over medium, melt the sugar with 1 tbsp water and cook 2–3 minutes until amber.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Carefully add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster B, fish sauce, pepper, and 1/4 cup water; stir until smooth.

steps.title: Simmer salmon
steps.text: Add the salmon and simmer 8 minutes, spooning sauce over, until glazed and cooked.

steps.title: Simmer pork
steps.text: Add the pork and simmer 10 minutes until sticky and tender.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with scallions and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
recipes.description: Turmeric-marinated grilled skewers with a creamy, spicy peanut dipping sauce.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Booster B; mix with turmeric, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp oil. Toss with the protein and thread onto skewers.

steps.title: Peanut sauce
steps.text: Simmer 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster B, peanut butter, coconut milk, and soy 2 minutes until smooth. Add lime juice.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Grill or broil on high, 4–5 minutes per side, until charred and cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with the peanut sauce and rice or cucumber.

recipes.title: Massaman Potato Curry
recipes.description: A mild, warmly spiced Thai curry with tender potatoes, peanuts, and a hint of tamarind.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the protein in 1 tbsp oil in a pot over medium-high, 5 minutes.

steps.title: Paste
steps.text: Add the curry paste, 1 cube Base 2, 2 cubes Booster B, and fry 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the coconut milk, 1 cube Base 4, potatoes, and 1 cup water. Simmer covered 25 minutes until the potatoes are tender (beef: 40 minutes, adding the potatoes after 15).

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in tamarind and peanuts; season with fish sauce or salt. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Nasi Goreng with Fried Egg
recipes.description: Indonesian sweet-soy fried rice with a fried egg, crisp shallots, and cucumber. Any time of day.

ingredients.item: kecap manis or soy + brown sugar

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Stir-fry the chicken in 1 tbsp oil over high 4 minutes.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Stir-fry the shrimp in 1 tbsp oil over high 2 minutes.

steps.title: Paste
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster B, and sambal; fry 30 seconds.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Add the rice and kecap manis; stir-fry 3 minutes until dark and toasty.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with fried eggs, cucumber, and fried shallots.

recipes.title: Thai Peanut Noodle Salad
recipes.description: Rainbow vegetables and noodles in a creamy, zesty peanut-lime dressing. Made for meal prep.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Cook the noodles, rinse in cold water, and drain.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster B for 20 seconds; whisk with peanut butter, lime juice, and 2 tbsp water.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss everything with the dressing.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Garnish with cilantro and peanuts.

recipes.title: Shrimp Summer Rolls with Peanut Dip
recipes.description: Translucent rice-paper rolls filled with shrimp, herbs, and noodles, served with a creamy peanut-hoisin dip.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water 3 minutes; drain and rinse cold.

steps.title: Dip
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster B for 20 seconds; whisk with peanut butter, hoisin, and 2 tbsp warm water.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Dip a rice paper in warm water 5 seconds. Lay on a board, add lettuce, noodles, herbs, and protein; fold in the sides and roll tightly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve immediately with the dip.

recipes.title: Arroz Caldo (Filipino Ginger Rice Porridge)
recipes.description: Golden, gingery chicken rice porridge topped with garlic chips, scallions, and a soft egg. Filipino breakfast comfort.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: In a pot, melt 2 cubes Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B. Add the rice and turmeric; stir 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the broth and fish sauce.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Simmer 30–35 minutes, stirring often, until the rice is thick and creamy.

steps.title: Shred
steps.text: Remove the chicken, shred it, and return it to the pot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with halved eggs, garlic chips, scallions, and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Filipino Chicken Adobo
recipes.description: Chicken braised in vinegar, soy, garlic, and bay until sticky and tender. Filipino comfort food at its best.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the meat skin-side down in a dry pot over medium-high, 6 minutes.

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, vinegar, soy, bay, peppercorns, and 1/2 cup water. Bring to a boil, then simmer covered 20 minutes (pork: 45 minutes).

steps.title: Reduce
steps.text: Uncover and simmer 8 minutes more until the sauce is syrupy and clings to the meat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with rice and plenty of sauce.

recipes.title: Crispy Thai Omelette (Kai Jeow)
recipes.description: A puffy, crispy-edged Thai omelette with fish sauce and herbs, served over rice with sriracha.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B for 15 seconds. Whisk vigorously with the eggs, fish sauce, cornstarch, and 1 tbsp water until frothy.

steps.title: Pork
steps.text: Stir the raw ground pork into the egg mixture, breaking it up.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Heat 3 tbsp oil in a small wok over high until shimmering. Pour the eggs in from a height so they puff. Fry 1 1/2 minutes until crisp and golden, then flip and fry 1 minute.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drain briefly and slide onto rice. Serve with sriracha.

recipes.title: Green Curry Turkey Meatballs
recipes.description: Tender, herby meatballs simmered in a creamy green coconut curry sauce.

steps.title: Meatballs
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Base 3; mix into the meat with panko and 1/2 tsp salt. Roll into 20 balls.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown in 1 tbsp oil in a deep skillet over medium-high, 5 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add the curry paste, 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster B, and coconut milk. Simmer 10 minutes until the meatballs are cooked.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the spinach. Serve over rice with lime.

recipes.title: Thai Fish Cakes with Cucumber Relish
recipes.description: Bouncy, fragrant fish cakes with green beans and lime leaf, plus a sweet-sour cucumber relish.

steps.title: Relish
steps.text: Mix the cucumber, vinegar, sugar, and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Pulse the fish, egg, curry paste, 1 cube Base 3, and 1 cube Booster B (softened) in a food processor to a sticky paste. Fold in the green beans.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: With oiled hands, form 16 small patties.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Shallow-fry in 1/4 inch of oil over medium-high, 2 minutes per side, until golden and springy. Serve with the relish.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Beef Noodle Bowls (Bún)
recipes.description: Vermicelli bowls piled with charred lemongrass beef, crunchy vegetables, herbs, and tangy nuoc cham.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster B; toss with the protein and 1 tsp sugar.

steps.title: Nuoc cham
steps.text: Whisk the fish sauce, lime juice, remaining sugar, 1/4 cup water, and 1 cube Booster B (melted) until the sugar dissolves.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Cook and rinse the vermicelli.

steps.title: Char
steps.text: Sear the protein in a very hot skillet, 2 minutes per side, until charred.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Layer lettuce, noodles, vegetables, and protein; spoon over nuoc cham and top with peanuts and herbs.

recipes.title: Coconut-Lime Shrimp Skillet
recipes.description: Juicy shrimp in a light, zingy coconut-lime sauce with herbs. Fifteen minutes to the table.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Season the shrimp and sear in 1 tbsp oil over high heat, 1 minute per side. Remove.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Lower heat. Add 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster B, and the coconut milk; simmer 2 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Return the shrimp; add lime zest and juice. Serve over rice with cilantro.

recipes.title: Thai Pineapple Fried Rice
recipes.description: Sweet pineapple, cashews, and curry-kissed rice tossed with shrimp, chicken, or tofu.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Stir-fry the protein in 1 tbsp oil over high until cooked; remove.

steps.title: Pineapple
steps.text: Stir-fry the pineapple and cashews 2 minutes until lightly charred.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Add the rice, curry powder, 1 cube Base 1, and 1 cube Booster B; stir-fry 3 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Return the protein, season with fish sauce, and toss.

recipes.title: Curry Laksa Noodle Soup
recipes.description: A rich, spicy coconut-curry noodle soup with tofu puffs, sprouts, and a squeeze of lime. Malaysian hawker comfort.

steps.title: Paste
steps.text: Fry the curry paste in 1 tbsp oil 1 minute. Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster B, and 1 cube Booster C; fry 1 minute more.

steps.title: Broth
steps.text: Add the broth, coconut milk, and 1 cube Base 4; simmer 8 minutes.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Add the protein and simmer until cooked.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Cook the noodles separately and divide among bowls.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle the soup over the noodles; top with sprouts, cilantro, and lime.

recipes.title: Drunken Noodles (Pad Kee Mao)
recipes.description: Wide rice noodles stir-fried over high heat with chilies, basil, and a dark, peppery sauce.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Soak or cook the noodles until just pliable.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Stir-fry the protein and chilies in 1 tbsp oil over very high heat until browned.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 2 cubes Booster B, oyster sauce, dark soy, and tomatoes; toss 1 minute.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the noodles and toss 2 minutes until coated and lightly charred. Fold in the basil.

recipes.title: Thai Yellow Chickpea & Sweet Potato Curry
recipes.description: A mellow, golden coconut curry with sweet potatoes and chickpeas (or lentils). Budget-friendly comfort.

steps.title: Paste
steps.text: Fry the curry paste with 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B for 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the sweet potato, coconut milk, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cup water. Simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Chickpeas
steps.text: Add the chickpeas and simmer 5 minutes more.

steps.title: Lentils
steps.text: Add the lentils with an extra 1 cup water at the start and simmer until creamy.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the spinach and season with lime and salt. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sticky Lemongrass Tofu Bowls
recipes.description: Crispy tofu glazed in a sticky, sweet-salty lemongrass sauce with herby rice and pickled vegetables.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Toss the tofu with cornstarch and salt. Fry in 3 tbsp oil over medium-high, turning, 10 minutes until crisp.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster B, soy, and sugar; toss 1–2 minutes until sticky.

steps.title: Bowl
steps.text: Serve over rice with sliced cucumber, shredded carrot, and herbs.

recipes.title: Ginger Poached Chicken Rice (Hainanese-Style)
recipes.description: Silky poached chicken over fragrant rice cooked in the broth, with ginger-scallion and chili sauces.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Simmer the broth with 1 cube Base 1. Add the chicken and poach gently 15 minutes until 165°F. Move to ice water for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Melt the remaining 1 cube Base 1 in a pot with 1 tbsp chicken fat or oil. Add the rice and stir 1 minute, then add 2 cups poaching broth. Cover and cook 15 minutes on low.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Booster B with 2 tbsp hot oil to make a ginger-scallion sauce.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slice the chicken and serve over rice with cucumber, ginger-scallion sauce, chili sauce, soy, and a cup of the broth.

recipes.title: Breakfast Egg Banh Mi
recipes.description: A crusty baguette with jammy fried eggs, pickled carrots, cucumber, cilantro, and chili mayo.

steps.title: Pickle
steps.text: Toss the carrot with vinegar and a pinch of sugar and salt.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs over medium-high until crispy-edged with runny yolks. In the last 30 seconds, add 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster B to the pan and spoon the sauce over the eggs.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Split and warm the baguettes. Spread with sriracha mayo, then add the eggs, ham, pickles, cucumber, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Thai Peanut Chicken Wraps
recipes.description: Juicy chicken and crunchy slaw in a creamy peanut sauce, rolled up for a portable lunch.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Sear the protein in 1 tsp oil over medium-high, 6 minutes for chicken, until cooked.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster B for 20 seconds; whisk with the peanut butter, lime juice, and 1 tbsp water.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the slaw with half the sauce and the protein with the rest.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Fill the tortillas, roll tightly, and slice.

recipes.title: Thai Cashew Chicken
recipes.description: Tender chicken, toasted cashews, and onions in a savory, slightly sweet chili-jam sauce.

ingredients.item: chili jam or sweet chili sauce

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Toss the protein with cornstarch; stir-fry in 2 tbsp oil over high 5 minutes. Remove.

steps.title: Onions
steps.text: Stir-fry the onion 2 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster B, oyster sauce, chili jam, and 2 tbsp water.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Return the protein with the cashews; toss 1 minute. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Thai Red Lentil Coconut Soup
recipes.description: A velvety red lentil soup with coconut, red curry, and lime. Pantry-friendly and deeply warming.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Fry the curry paste with 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster B for 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the lentils and broth; simmer 15 minutes until soft.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Stir in the coconut milk and 1 cube Base 4; simmer 3 minutes. Blend partially for a creamy body.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Add lime juice and salt to taste; top with cilantro and a swirl of coconut milk.

recipes.title: Yellow Dal Tadka
recipes.description: Creamy, golden lentils finished with a sizzling tempering of mustard seeds, cumin, and curry leaves.

ingredients.item: yellow split lentils (toor or moong dal)

steps.title: Cook lentils
steps.text: Simmer the lentils, water, turmeric, and 1 cube Base 1 for 20–25 minutes, whisking occasionally, until completely soft and creamy. Add the tomato for the last 5 minutes.

steps.title: Tadka
steps.text: In a small pan, heat the ghee over medium-high. Add 2 cubes Booster C and fry 60 seconds until the mustard seeds pop and it smells toasty.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Pour the sizzling tadka into the dal and stir. Season with salt and lemon juice; thin with hot water to your liking.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over rice with cilantro.

recipes.title: Chana Masala
recipes.description: Chickpeas simmered in a tangy, deeply spiced tomato-onion gravy. A North Indian staple.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: In a pot over medium, melt 2 cubes Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C; fry 2 minutes until fragrant.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the tomatoes and chickpeas with liquid. Simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken the gravy.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the garam masala and amchur. Season with salt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with cilantro and serve with naan or rice.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Korma
recipes.description: A mild, luxurious nutty cream curry with tender chicken. A family favorite for spice-shy eaters.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Season the protein with salt and brown in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high, 5 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster C; fry 1 minute. Add 1/2 cup water and simmer 10 minutes.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Lower heat. Stir in 2 cubes Base 4 and the yogurt until silky (don't boil after adding yogurt). Add garam masala.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with almonds and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Saag with Crispy Tofu
recipes.description: A silky spiced spinach purée with golden pan-fried tofu cubes (or paneer, if you have it).

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Fry the tofu in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high, turning, 8 minutes until golden. Remove and salt.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: In the same pan, fry 1 cube Booster C 30 seconds. Add 2 cubes Base 3 and the spinach; cook 4 minutes.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend until smooth (or leave rustic), then return to the pan with 1 cube Base 4 and garam masala.

steps.title: Chickpeas
steps.text: Stir in the chickpeas and simmer 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fold in the crispy tofu and serve with naan.

recipes.title: Keema Matar (Spiced Mince & Peas)
recipes.description: Fragrant spiced ground meat with sweet peas. Great with flatbread, rice, or stuffed into toasted buns.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the meat in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high, 7 minutes.

steps.title: Masala
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2 and 2 cubes Booster C; fry 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the yogurt and 1/2 cup water; simmer 8 minutes. Add the peas and garam masala and cook 3 minutes more.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season with salt and lemon; serve with naan or buns.

recipes.title: Aloo Gobi with Chickpeas
recipes.description: Turmeric-golden potatoes and cauliflower, pan-roasted with spices and chickpeas. A dry, crispy-edged curry.

steps.title: Tempering
steps.text: In a large lidded skillet, fry 2 cubes Booster C in 2 tbsp oil 1 minute.

steps.title: Steam-fry
steps.text: Add the potatoes, cauliflower, turmeric, 1 cube Base 1, 1 tsp salt, and 3 tbsp water. Cover and cook over medium 12 minutes, stirring twice.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Uncover, add the chickpeas, and cook 6 more minutes until the edges brown.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Sprinkle with garam masala and cilantro; serve with roti.

recipes.title: Rajma (Punjabi Kidney Bean Curry)
recipes.description: Creamy kidney beans in a thick, spiced tomato gravy over rice. Punjabi Sunday comfort.

steps.title: Masala
steps.text: Melt 2 cubes Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C in a pot over medium; fry 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the tomatoes, beans with liquid, and 1 cup water. Simmer 20 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in garam masala and kasuri methi. Season with salt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over rice with sliced onion and lemon.

recipes.title: Red Lentil & Spinach Dal
recipes.description: Quick-cooking red lentils turned silky and green with spinach and a tangy citrus-herb finish.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Simmer the lentils, water, turmeric, and 1 cube Base 1 for 15 minutes until broken down.

steps.title: Greens
steps.text: Stir in 1 cube Base 3 and the spinach until wilted.

steps.title: Tadka
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Booster C in 1 tbsp ghee until popping and pour over.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season with salt and lime; serve with rice.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Tandoori Chicken & Cauliflower
recipes.description: Yogurt-marinated, smoky-red chicken and cauliflower roasted until charred. One pan, minimal effort.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Base 2 and 2 cubes Booster C; mix with yogurt, chili powder, lemon juice, and 1 1/2 tsp salt. Coat the chicken and cauliflower.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Spread on a sheet pan with the onion. Roast at 450°F for 30 minutes until the chicken reaches 175°F and edges char.

steps.title: Char
steps.text: Broil 2 minutes for extra color.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with naan, lemon wedges, and mint yogurt.

recipes.title: Goan Coconut Fish Curry
recipes.description: Tender white fish in a tangy, spicy, red coconut curry. Coastal India in a skillet.

steps.title: Masala
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C with the chili powder in a skillet; fry 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the coconut milk, 1 cube Base 4, tamarind, and 1/2 cup water; simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Fish
steps.text: Add the seasoned fish and simmer gently 6–8 minutes until it flakes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over rice with cilantro.

recipes.title: Weeknight Chicken Biryani
recipes.description: Fragrant layered rice with spiced chicken, crispy onions, and herbs — simplified into one pot.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Mix the protein with yogurt, garam masala, and 1 tsp salt.

steps.title: Masala
steps.text: In a heavy pot, melt 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 2 cubes Booster C; fry 2 minutes. Add the protein and cook 6 minutes.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread the drained rice on top. Add 2 1/4 cups boiling water and 1 tsp salt; don't stir.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Cover tightly and cook on low 20 minutes. Rest 5 minutes off the heat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fluff gently, mixing layers, and top with fried onions and herbs.

recipes.title: South Indian Egg Curry
recipes.description: Halved boiled eggs blistered in spices and simmered in a creamy coconut-tomato gravy.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Boil the eggs 9 minutes, cool, peel, and score shallowly.

steps.title: Blister
steps.text: Fry the eggs with the turmeric in 1 tbsp oil 2 minutes until spotted golden. Remove.

steps.title: Gravy
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C 1 minute. Add the tomato, coconut milk, 1 cube Base 4, and 1/3 cup water; simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Return the eggs and simmer 3 minutes. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Rogan Josh-Style Beef Curry
recipes.description: A deep red, aromatic Kashmiri-style curry with tender beef. Slow-cooked flavor in under an hour.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in 1 tbsp oil over high heat. Remove.

steps.title: Masala
steps.text: Add 2 cubes Base 2, 2 cubes Booster C, cinnamon, and chili powder; fry 2 minutes.

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: Return the beef, stir in the yogurt a spoonful at a time, and add 1 1/2 cups water. Cover and simmer 35–40 minutes until tender (or pressure-cook 20 minutes).

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in garam masala and season. Serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: Masala Omelette
recipes.description: An Indian street-style omelette loaded with onion, tomato, chili, and cilantro. Fold into buttered toast.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster C for 15 seconds. Beat with the eggs, onion, tomato, chili, cilantro, and salt.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Pour into a hot buttered skillet over medium; cook 2 minutes until the base sets, then flip and cook 1 minute.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fold over toast or eat with ketchup.

recipes.title: Chickpea Flour Pancakes (Besan Chilla)
recipes.description: Savory, protein-rich chickpea-flour crêpes speckled with herbs. Breakfast, lunch, or snack.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster C for 15 seconds; whisk with the besan, water, and 1/2 tsp salt until smooth like pancake batter. Fold in onion and cilantro.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Heat a nonstick pan over medium with 1 tsp oil. Pour a ladle and spread thin. Cook 2 minutes until the edges lift, flip, and cook 1 minute.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Repeat and serve with yogurt or chutney.

recipes.title: Spiced Potato & Egg Hash (Aloo Anda)
recipes.description: Crispy, turmeric-spiced potatoes with eggs cooked right on top. A hearty desi breakfast.

steps.title: Par-cook
steps.text: Microwave the potatoes covered with 2 tbsp water for 4 minutes.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Booster C in 2 tbsp oil 30 seconds. Add the potatoes, turmeric, and 1 cube Base 1; cook 8 minutes until crisp.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 3 minutes until set.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with cilantro and chili flakes.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Kathi Rolls
recipes.description: Charred tikka-spiced chicken wrapped in flaky flatbread with pickled onions and mint chutney.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Mix 2 cubes Booster C (softened) with the yogurt and 1 tsp salt; coat the protein.

steps.title: Pickle
steps.text: Toss the onion with lemon juice and salt.

steps.title: Char
steps.text: Sear in a very hot skillet with 1 tbsp oil, 3–4 minutes per side, until charred.

steps.title: Chutney
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and stir with 2 tbsp yogurt for a quick mint-style chutney.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Warm the parathas and fill with protein, onions, and chutney.

recipes.title: Chana Chaat Salad
recipes.description: A tangy, crunchy, sweet-spicy chickpea salad. India's favorite street snack.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster C; mix with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss all the vegetables and chickpeas in the dressing.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drizzle with tamarind chutney and top with sev.

recipes.title: Tandoori Shrimp Skewers
recipes.description: Smoky, charred shrimp skewers with a cool herbed yogurt dip. Ready in minutes.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Booster C; mix with half the yogurt, paprika, and salt. Toss with the shrimp and skewer.

steps.title: Dip
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and stir into the remaining yogurt.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Grill or broil on high 2–3 minutes per side until charred and pink.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Squeeze lemon over and serve with the dip.

recipes.title: Weeknight Dal Makhani
recipes.description: Black lentils and kidney beans in a buttery, creamy tomato gravy. A restaurant favorite, simplified.

steps.title: Masala
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C with the butter; fry 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the lentils, beans, tomato purée, and 1 1/2 cups water. Simmer 25 minutes, stirring and mashing often, until thick and creamy.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Stir in 1 cube Base 4 and garam masala.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with naan or rice and a pat of butter on top.

recipes.title: Chettinad Pepper Chicken
recipes.description: A dry, intensely peppery South Indian chicken fry with curry leaves. Bold and aromatic.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Toss the chicken with turmeric and 1 tsp salt.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Fry 2 cubes Booster C in 2 tbsp oil 1 minute. Add 1 cube Base 1 and the chicken; cook over high 8 minutes.

steps.title: Pepper
steps.text: Add the black pepper and fennel; cook 4 more minutes until the chicken is browned, dry, and coated.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with rice and lemon.

recipes.title: South Indian Lemon Rice with Chickpeas
recipes.description: Bright yellow, lemony rice tempered with mustard seeds and curry leaves, studded with chickpeas or eggs.

steps.title: Temper
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Booster C with the peanuts in 2 tbsp oil until popping and golden.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Add the turmeric, 1 cube Base 3, and the rice; toss 3 minutes until hot and evenly yellow.

steps.title: Chickpeas
steps.text: Fold in the chickpeas and heat 1 minute.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Squeeze in the lemon juice and season with salt.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Top each serving with boiled egg quarters.

recipes.title: Turkey Kofta Curry
recipes.description: Tender spiced meatballs simmered in a creamy, mildly spiced tomato curry.

steps.title: Kofta
steps.text: Mix the meat with 1 cube Booster C (softened), cilantro, garam masala, and 1 tsp salt. Roll into 20 balls.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown in 1 tbsp oil 5 minutes. Remove.

steps.title: Gravy
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C 1 minute; add the tomatoes and 1/2 cup water. Simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Stir in 1 cube Base 4, add the kofta, and simmer covered 10 minutes until cooked through.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Quick Vegetable Sambar
recipes.description: A tangy tamarind-lentil stew loaded with vegetables. South Indian soul food.

steps.title: Lentils
steps.text: Simmer the lentils in 3 cups water 15 minutes until soft.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Add the vegetables, tamarind, sambar powder, 1 cube Base 1, and 1 cube Base 2. Simmer 10 minutes until the vegetables are tender.

steps.title: Tadka
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Booster C in 1 tbsp oil until popping and pour over.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season with salt and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Kerala Coconut Chicken Curry
recipes.description: A fragrant, coconut-rich curry with black pepper and curry leaves from India's southwest coast.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Fry 2 cubes Booster C and 1 cube Base 1 in 1 tbsp coconut oil 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the protein and pepper; stir 2 minutes. Add half the coconut milk and 1/2 cup water; simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in the remaining coconut milk and 1 cube Base 4; simmer 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Masala Turkey Burgers with Mint Yogurt
recipes.description: Juicy spiced turkey burgers with a cool mint yogurt and pickled onions. A backyard-meets-tandoor mashup.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix the meat with 1 cube Booster C (softened) and 3/4 tsp salt. Form 4 patties.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Grill or sear 4–5 minutes per side until 165°F.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and stir into the yogurt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve on toasted buns with the yogurt sauce, sliced onion, and lettuce.

recipes.title: Bombay Potato & Chickpea Hash
recipes.description: Crispy cumin potatoes and chickpeas in a tangy tomato masala, topped with fried eggs if you like.

steps.title: Par-cook
steps.text: Microwave the potatoes 4 minutes.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Booster C in 2 tbsp oil; add the potatoes and cook 8 minutes until golden.

steps.title: Masala
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2 and the chickpeas; toss 3 minutes.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs and slide on top.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Garnish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Mung Dal Khichdi
recipes.description: India's ultimate comfort bowl: rice and lentils cooked together into a soft, savory porridge.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Rinse the rice and dal. Simmer with 5 cups water, turmeric, 1 cube Base 1, and 1 tsp salt, 20–25 minutes until soft and porridge-like. Add the vegetables in the last 5 minutes.

steps.title: Tadka
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Booster C in the ghee until popping; pour over.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with yogurt and pickle.

recipes.title: Masala Tofu Scramble
recipes.description: A turmeric-golden tofu scramble with tomato and spices, inspired by egg bhurji. Plant-based and protein-packed.

steps.title: Masala
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C in 1 tbsp oil 1 minute.

steps.title: Scramble
steps.text: Add the tofu, turmeric, tomato, and salt; cook 5 minutes until hot and golden.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with cilantro and serve with toast or roti.

recipes.title: Tandoori Salmon with Cucumber Raita
recipes.description: Spice-crusted salmon roasted until charred at the edges, with a cool cucumber-herb raita.

steps.title: Rub
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Booster C; mix with paprika and 2 tbsp yogurt. Coat the salmon.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Roast at 450°F for 10–12 minutes until flaky and charred at the edges.

steps.title: Raita
steps.text: Mix the remaining yogurt with the cucumber, 1 cube Base 3 (thawed), and salt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with rice and raita.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Bowls
recipes.description: Warm-spiced, charred chicken over fluffy grains with cucumber-tomato salad, pickles, and garlicky yogurt sauce.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C; mix with cumin, paprika, cinnamon, 1 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp oil. Coat the protein.

steps.title: Char
steps.text: Sear the chicken in a hot skillet 5–6 minutes per side until charred and 175°F. Rest and slice thin.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Roast the coated chickpeas at 425°F for 20 minutes until crisp.

steps.title: Grains
steps.text: Pour 1 1/4 cups boiling salted water over the couscous, cover 5 minutes, and fluff.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 4 and stir into the yogurt with a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Layer grains, protein, cucumber-tomato salad, pickles, and a big drizzle of sauce.

recipes.title: Baked Falafel with Tahini Sauce
recipes.description: Crisp-outside, herb-green-inside falafel baked instead of fried, with lemony tahini.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Pulse the chickpeas, 2 cubes Base 3 (softened), 1 cube Booster C, flour, baking powder, and 1 tsp salt to a coarse paste that holds together.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Form into 16 small patties on an oiled sheet pan and brush the tops with oil.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 425°F for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.

steps.title: Tahini
steps.text: Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, 1/4 cup water, and salt until smooth.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Stuff into pitas with tomato and tahini.

recipes.title: Mujadara (Lentils, Rice & Crispy Onions)
recipes.description: Humble, deeply savory lentils and rice crowned with sweet crispy onions. A Levantine classic.

steps.title: Lentils
steps.text: Simmer the lentils in 4 cups salted water 12 minutes until just tender. Drain, reserving 2 cups liquid.

steps.title: Onions
steps.text: Meanwhile fry the onions in the olive oil over medium-high, 15–18 minutes, until deep brown and crisp. Remove half for topping.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: To the remaining onions add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster C, cumin, and the rice; stir 1 minute. Add the lentils and reserved liquid. Cover and cook on low 18 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fluff and top with crispy onions and yogurt.

recipes.title: Turkish Eggs (Çılbır) with Chili Butter
recipes.description: Soft poached eggs on cool garlicky yogurt, drizzled with sizzling chili butter. Mop it all up with bread.

steps.title: Yogurt
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and stir into the yogurt with a pinch of salt. Spread on plates.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Poach the eggs in barely simmering water with a splash of vinegar, 3 minutes. Lift onto the yogurt.

steps.title: Chili butter
steps.text: Melt the butter with 1 cube Booster C and the Aleppo pepper until foamy.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the butter over the eggs, scatter dill, and serve with toast.

recipes.title: Kofta Kebabs with Tahini Sauce
recipes.description: Juicy spiced kebabs grilled or seared, served with tahini sauce, herbs, and warm flatbread.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix the meat with 1 cube Booster C (softened), parsley, allspice, and 1 tsp salt. Shape into 8 long kebabs on skewers.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Grill or sear over high heat, turning, 8–10 minutes until charred and cooked through.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Base 4; whisk with tahini, lemon juice, and water to drizzling consistency.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve on flatbreads with sauce, sliced onion, and tomato.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chickpea & Apricot Tagine
recipes.description: A sweet-savory, warmly spiced stew with chickpeas (or chicken), apricots, and couscous.

ingredients.item: ras el hanout or cinnamon + cumin

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster C, 1 cube Booster A, and the ras el hanout in 1 tbsp oil 2 minutes.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Add the chicken and cook 5 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the tomatoes, apricots, protein, and 1 cup water. Simmer 20 minutes until thick.

steps.title: Couscous
steps.text: Pour 1 1/4 cups boiling salted water over the couscous; cover 5 minutes and fluff.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the tagine over couscous with almonds and cilantro.

recipes.title: Hummus with Spiced Beef & Pine Nuts
recipes.description: Silky hummus topped with sizzling spiced beef and toasted pine nuts. A dip that eats like dinner.

steps.title: Hummus
steps.text: Stir 1 cube Base 4 (thawed) into the hummus to make it extra creamy. Spread in a wide shallow bowl.

steps.title: Beef
steps.text: Brown the beef in 1 tbsp oil over high heat 5 minutes.

steps.title: Chickpeas
steps.text: Fry the chickpeas in 2 tbsp oil until blistered, 6 minutes.

steps.title: Spice
steps.text: Add 1 cube Booster C and the pine nuts; fry 2 minutes until the nuts are golden.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon over the hummus with the pan oil. Serve with pitas.

recipes.title: Herby Tabbouleh with Grilled Chicken
recipes.description: A parsley-packed bulgur salad with tomatoes and lemon, topped with juicy grilled chicken.

steps.title: Bulgur
steps.text: Pour 1/2 cup boiling water over the bulgur, cover 10 minutes, and fluff.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A; whisk with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and grill or sear 5 minutes per side. Rest and slice.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the bulgur, herbs, and tomatoes with most of the dressing.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with chicken or chickpeas and the remaining dressing.

recipes.title: Harira-Style Lentil & Chickpea Soup
recipes.description: A hearty Moroccan tomato soup with lentils, chickpeas, herbs, and warm spices.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster C in a pot with the cinnamon 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the lentils, tomatoes, and broth; simmer 25 minutes.

steps.title: Chickpeas
steps.text: Add the chickpeas and herbs; simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Finish with lemon juice and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Spiced Meat Flatbreads (Lahmacun-Style)
recipes.description: Thin flatbreads spread with a spiced meat-tomato paste and baked crisp. Roll up with herbs and lemon.

steps.title: Paste
steps.text: Mix the raw meat with 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C (softened), tomato paste, and 1/2 tsp salt into a spreadable paste.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Spread thinly over the flatbreads, right to the edges.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake on sheet pans at 475°F for 10–12 minutes until the meat is cooked and edges are crisp.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with parsley, onion, and lemon, then roll up.

recipes.title: Spiced Chicken & Freekeh Pilaf
recipes.description: Smoky, nutty green wheat cooked pilaf-style with warmly spiced chicken and toasted almonds.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Season the chicken with salt and baharat; brown in 1 tbsp oil 4 minutes per side. Remove.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster C, and the freekeh; stir 2 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Add the broth, nestle in the chicken, cover, and simmer 20 minutes until the grain is tender and the chicken cooked.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with almonds and serve with yogurt.

recipes.title: Persian Herb Frittata (Kuku Sabzi)
recipes.description: A vividly green, herb-packed frittata with walnuts. Great hot, cold, or tucked into flatbread.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk the eggs with 2 cubes Base 3 (thawed), 1 cube Booster C (softened), baking powder, and 1 tsp salt. Fold in the herbs and walnuts — it should be more green than yellow.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a 10-inch nonstick oven-safe skillet over medium. Pour in the mixture and cook 6 minutes until the edges set.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Transfer to a 375°F oven for 12–14 minutes until set in the center.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cut into wedges and serve with yogurt.

recipes.title: Ful Medames (Egyptian Fava Beans)
recipes.description: Warm, garlicky mashed fava beans with lemon, cumin, and olive oil. The breakfast of Cairo.

steps.title: Warm
steps.text: Simmer the beans in their liquid 5 minutes. Mash roughly.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Stir in 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Booster C, cumin, and lemon juice. Season with salt.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Top with halved boiled eggs.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drizzle with olive oil, scatter tomato, and serve with pitas.

recipes.title: Green Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs baked into a bed of garlicky greens, herbs, and spice, finished with feta. A fresh twist on the red classic.

steps.title: Greens
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Booster C in 2 tbsp olive oil 30 seconds. Add the chard and cook 4 minutes until wilted.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 2 cubes Base 3, the spinach, and 1/4 cup water; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Make wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 5 minutes until the whites set.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with feta and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Sumac Onion Chicken Flatbread (Musakhan-Style)
recipes.description: Roasted chicken over flatbread smothered in jammy sumac onions. Palestinian-inspired and spectacular.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Rub the chicken with 1 tbsp sumac, salt, and oil. Roast at 425°F for 22–25 minutes.

steps.title: Onions
steps.text: Meanwhile cook the onions in the olive oil over medium 15 minutes until soft and sweet. Stir in 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster C, and the remaining sumac.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Spread the onions over the flatbreads, top with sliced chicken and pine nuts.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Bake 5 minutes until the bread edges crisp.

recipes.title: Spiced Rice-Stuffed Peppers
recipes.description: Bell peppers filled with warmly spiced meat (or lentils) and rice, baked in a tomato sauce.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Brown the protein 5 minutes (lentils: just warm). Add 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C; stir in the rice and parsley.

steps.title: Stuff
steps.text: Fill the peppers and stand in a baking dish.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Stir 1 cube Base 2 into the tomatoes with 1/2 cup water and pour around the peppers.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Cover and bake at 400°F for 25 minutes, then uncover 10 minutes until the peppers are tender.

recipes.title: Jeweled Couscous Salad
recipes.description: Fluffy couscous studded with dried fruit, pistachios, herbs, and chickpeas in a fragrant dressing.

steps.title: Couscous
steps.text: Pour 1 1/4 cups boiling salted water over the couscous; cover 5 minutes and fluff.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster C; whisk with lemon juice and 2 tbsp olive oil.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss everything together.

notes: Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Chermoula Shrimp with Couscous
recipes.description: Shrimp tossed in a zesty North African herb-and-spice sauce, over buttery couscous.

steps.title: Couscous
steps.text: Pour 1 1/4 cups boiling salted water and butter over the couscous; cover 5 minutes.

steps.title: Chermoula
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster C; mix with lemon juice and 2 tbsp olive oil.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear the shrimp in a hot skillet 1–2 minutes per side. Off heat, toss with half the chermoula.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over couscous with the remaining chermoula.

recipes.title: Baharat Salmon with Herby Bulgur
recipes.description: Warm-spiced salmon over lemony herb bulgur with a yogurt drizzle. Weeknight-healthy and big on flavor.

steps.title: Bulgur
steps.text: Simmer the bulgur in 1 cup salted water 12 minutes. Stir in 1 cube Base 3 and parsley.

steps.title: Rub
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Booster C; mix with baharat and coat the salmon.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Roast at 425°F for 10–12 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over bulgur with yogurt.

recipes.title: Za'atar Egg & Labneh Toast
recipes.description: Thick toast swiped with tangy labneh, topped with jammy eggs, za'atar, and herb oil.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Boil the eggs 6 1/2 minutes; cool and peel.

steps.title: Herb oil
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster C with 1 tbsp olive oil 20 seconds.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread labneh on toast, top with halved eggs, drizzle with herb oil, and sprinkle with za'atar.

recipes.title: Tikka Chickpea Quinoa Bowls
recipes.description: Charred tikka chickpeas (or chicken) over quinoa with cucumber, red onion, and green chutney yogurt.

steps.title: Quinoa
steps.text: Simmer the quinoa in 2 cups salted water 15 minutes; fluff.

steps.title: Tikka
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C in 1 tbsp oil; add the protein and cook 8–10 minutes until charred.

steps.title: Chutney
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and stir into the yogurt.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Serve quinoa topped with protein, cucumber, onion, and chutney yogurt.

recipes.title: Vegetable Masala Quinoa with Eggs
recipes.description: A savory, upma-style spiced quinoa with peas and carrots, topped with a fried egg.

steps.title: Temper
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Booster C in 1 tbsp oil until popping. Add 1 cube Base 1 and the quinoa; stir 1 minute.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Add 1 1/2 cups water and the vegetables; simmer covered 14 minutes.

steps.title: Chickpeas
steps.text: Stir in the chickpeas for the last 3 minutes.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs and lay on top.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Garnish with cilantro and lemon.

recipes.title: Curried Chicken Salad Sandwiches
recipes.description: Creamy, mildly curried chicken salad with grapes, celery, and cashews. A deli classic.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster C for 20 seconds; stir into the yogurt.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Fold in the protein, grapes, celery, and cashews. Season with salt and lemon.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile onto bread with lettuce.

recipes.title: Masala Egg Muffins
recipes.description: Grab-and-go baked egg bites with spinach, peppers, and gentle spice. Meal-prep breakfast for the week.

steps.title: Prep
steps.text: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the turkey 5 minutes and divide among the cups.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster C for 20 seconds; whisk with the eggs and 1/2 tsp salt.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Divide the vegetables and cheese among the cups and pour in the egg mixture.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 18–20 minutes until puffed and set.

recipes.title: Masala Popcorn Chicken
recipes.description: Crunchy, spice-crusted bite-size chicken (or tofu) with a cooling herb yogurt dip.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Mix 1 cube Booster C (softened) with half the yogurt and 1 tsp salt; toss with the protein.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Dredge in cornstarch mixed with panko.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread on an oiled rack and bake at 450°F for 15 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp.

steps.title: Dip
steps.text: Stir 1 cube Base 3 (thawed) into the remaining yogurt and serve on the side.

recipes.title: Masala Sloppy Joes
recipes.description: A saucy, spiced take on sloppy joes (inspired by Indian keema pav) piled onto toasted buns.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the protein 6 minutes (lentils: warm 2 minutes).

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 2 cubes Base 2, 1 cube Booster C, tomato sauce, ketchup, and 1/4 cup water. Simmer 8 minutes until thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon onto toasted buttered buns with sliced onion.

recipes.title: Tikka Masala Pasta
recipes.description: Penne tossed in a creamy, spiced tikka sauce. The fusion weeknight dinner your family will request.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.text: Cook the penne, reserving 1/2 cup water.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Brown the protein in 1 tbsp oil 6 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster C, and the tomatoes; simmer 5 minutes. Stir in 1 cube Base 4.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the pasta and a splash of pasta water; toss until creamy. Garnish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Coconut Curry Mussels
recipes.description: Mussels steamed in a fragrant coconut-curry broth. Serve with crusty bread or rice.

steps.title: Broth
steps.text: In a wide pot, melt 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster C with the coconut milk and 1/4 cup water. Simmer 2 minutes.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Add the mussels, cover, and steam 5–6 minutes until open. Discard any that stay closed.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Add lime juice and cilantro. Serve with bread.

recipes.title: Curried Turkey & Sweet Potato Skillet
recipes.description: Ground turkey, tender sweet potato, and spinach in a gently spiced skillet. Simple, healthy, filling.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the meat in 1 tbsp oil 6 minutes. Remove.

steps.title: Potatoes
steps.text: Add the sweet potato, 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster C, and 1/3 cup water; cover and cook 10 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Return the meat and add the spinach; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with yogurt.

recipes.title: Singapore-Style Curry Noodles
recipes.description: Thin rice noodles stir-fried with curry powder, vegetables, egg, and shrimp or char siu.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Soak the noodles in hot water 5 minutes; drain.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Stir-fry the protein in 1 tbsp oil until cooked; remove. Scramble the eggs; remove.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Stir-fry the vegetables 2 minutes.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, 1 cube Booster C, curry powder, and 2 tbsp water.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the noodles, protein, and egg; toss 2 minutes until evenly yellow.

recipes.title: Chicken Tinga Tostadas
recipes.description: Smoky chipotle-tomato shredded chicken piled on crunchy tostadas with refried beans, crema, and avocado.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: In a skillet, melt 1 cube Base 2 and 2 cubes Booster D with the tomatoes; simmer 5 minutes and blend or mash until mostly smooth.

steps.title: Tinga
steps.text: Add the shredded meat and simmer 5 minutes until it soaks up the sauce.

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: Warm the refried beans.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread beans on tostadas, pile on tinga, and top with crema, avocado, and queso fresco.

recipes.title: Skillet Carnitas
recipes.description: Tender, juicy pork with crispy caramelized edges, made in one skillet without a slow cooker.

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: In a large skillet, combine the pork, 1 cube Base 1, 2 cubes Booster D, cumin, orange juice, 2 tsp salt, and 1 cup water. Simmer covered 30 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Uncover and cook over medium-high 10 minutes, stirring, until the liquid evaporates and the pork fries in its own fat until crispy.

steps.title: Shred
steps.text: Lightly break the pork apart with forks and squeeze over lime.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve in warm tortillas with onion and cilantro.

recipes.title: Smoky Black Bean Soup
recipes.description: Thick, smoky black bean soup topped with avocado, crema, and crunchy tortilla strips.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster D in a pot 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the beans with liquid and broth; simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend half the soup and return it to the pot. Add lime juice and salt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with avocado, sour cream, and tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Carne Asada Street Tacos
recipes.description: Citrus-marinated, charred flank steak in small corn tortillas with onion, cilantro, and salsa verde.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Booster D; mix with orange juice, juice of 1 lime, and 1 tsp salt. Coat the steak for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Grill or sear in a screaming-hot pan 4–5 minutes per side. Rest 5 minutes, then chop finely.

steps.title: Salsa
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and mix with lime juice as a quick salsa verde.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Double up warm tortillas, fill with steak, onion, cilantro, and salsa.

recipes.title: Baja Fish Tacos with Lime Crema
recipes.description: Crispy chili-dusted fish with crunchy cabbage and a cool, zesty lime crema in warm tortillas.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Booster D and toss with the fish and salt; dredge lightly in flour.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Shallow-fry in 1/4 inch of oil over medium-high, 2 minutes per side, until golden.

steps.title: Crema
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Base 4; whisk with lime juice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fill tortillas with fish, cabbage, avocado, and crema.

recipes.title: Creamy Green Chicken Enchiladas
recipes.description: Tortillas rolled around chicken (or black beans) and cheese, smothered in a creamy salsa verde sauce and baked bubbly.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Simmer 2 cubes Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster D, and the salsa verde with 1/2 cup water 3 minutes until creamy.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Mix the protein with half the cheese and 1/2 cup of sauce.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Warm the tortillas, fill, roll, and place seam-down in a baking dish.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour over the sauce, top with the remaining cheese, and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.title: Red Chile Beef & Bean Enchiladas
recipes.description: Classic Tex-Mex enchiladas filled with seasoned beef and beans under a rich red chile sauce and melted cheese.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Simmer 1 cube Base 2, 2 cubes Booster D, and the tomato sauce with 1/2 cup water 5 minutes.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Brown the beef 6 minutes; add 1 cube Base 2 and the beans.

steps.title: Bean filling
steps.text: Use 2 cans of beans, mashed slightly with 1 cube Base 2.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Dip tortillas in the sauce, fill, roll, and arrange in a dish.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Cover with sauce and cheese; bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.title: Pork Chile Verde
recipes.description: Tender pork braised in a tangy roasted tomatillo and green chile sauce. Spoon into tortillas or over rice.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Season and brown the meat in batches in 1 tbsp oil. Remove.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Broil the tomatillos 6 minutes until blistered. Blend with 2 cubes Base 3, 1 cube Booster D, and the broth.

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: Return the meat and sauce to the pot. Simmer covered 35 minutes for pork (20 for chicken) until tender.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with tortillas or rice, sour cream, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Arroz con Pollo
recipes.description: Chicken and rice cooked together in a savory tomato-pepper broth with peas and olives. One-pot Latin comfort.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Brown the seasoned chicken skin-side down in a Dutch oven 6 minutes. Remove.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Add the pepper, rice, 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster D; stir 2 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Add the broth, nestle in the chicken, cover, and simmer 25 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Scatter peas and olives on top, cover 5 minutes, and fluff.

recipes.title: Chipotle Chicken Burrito Bowls
recipes.description: Smoky charred chicken, cilantro-lime rice, black beans, corn salsa, and all the toppings.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D; coat the chicken with salt.

steps.title: Char
steps.text: Sear 5–6 minutes per side until charred. Rest and chop.

steps.title: Smoky beans
steps.text: For bean bowls, simmer one extra can of beans with the marinade until thick.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Toss the hot rice with 1 cube Base 3 and lime juice.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Layer rice, beans, protein, corn, avocado, and cheese.

recipes.title: Weeknight Pozole Rojo
recipes.description: A brick-red chile broth with tender meat and chewy hominy, topped with crunchy radish and cabbage.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 2 cubes Booster D in a pot 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the meat and broth; simmer 25 minutes (pork may need 40) until tender. Shred chicken if using.

steps.title: Hominy
steps.text: Add the hominy and simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle into bowls; top with radishes, cabbage, oregano, and lime.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
recipes.description: A smoky tomato broth loaded with chicken (or beans), corn, and crunchy tortilla strips.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster D in a pot.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the tomatoes and broth.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Add the chicken and simmer 15 minutes; shred and return.

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: Add the beans and simmer 10 minutes.

steps.title: Corn
steps.text: Add the corn for the last 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with chips, avocado, cheese, and lime.

recipes.title: Camarones a la Diabla
recipes.description: Shrimp in a fiery, smoky red chile sauce. Serve with rice and something cold to drink.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Simmer 1 cube Base 2, 2 cubes Booster D, tomato sauce, and hot sauce 3 minutes.

steps.title: Shrimp
steps.text: Add the shrimp and cook 3–4 minutes until pink.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Squeeze lime over and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Black Bean & Corn Quesadillas
recipes.description: Crispy, gooey quesadillas stuffed with smoky beans, corn, and cheese. Add chicken for extra protein.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Warm 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D in a skillet; add the beans and corn and mash lightly.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Stir in the chicken.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Fill half of each tortilla with filling and cheese; fold.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Cook in a dry skillet 3 minutes per side until golden and melty. Serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Taco-Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
recipes.description: Fluffy baked sweet potatoes loaded with smoky taco meat (or beans), cheese, and avocado.

steps.title: Potatoes
steps.text: Prick the sweet potatoes and microwave 10–12 minutes (or roast 45 minutes) until tender.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Brown the meat 6 minutes (beans: just warm). Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, and 1/4 cup water; simmer 3 minutes.

steps.title: Stuff
steps.text: Split the potatoes, fluff, and spoon in the filling.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Add cheese, avocado, and salsa.

recipes.title: Quick Birria-Style Tacos
recipes.description: Rich chile-braised beef in crispy, cheesy tacos with a cup of consommé for dipping.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Season and brown the beef in a Dutch oven. Add 2 cubes Base 2, 2 cubes Booster D, cinnamon, and broth.

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: Simmer covered 45 minutes (or pressure-cook 35) until shreddable. Shred the meat; keep the broth hot.

steps.title: Dip and crisp
steps.text: Dip each tortilla in the fat on top of the broth, lay in a hot skillet, add cheese and beef, fold, and crisp 2 minutes per side.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with cups of broth, onion, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Quick Mole-Style Chicken
recipes.description: A rich, dark, chocolate-kissed chile sauce over tender chicken. Celebration flavor, weeknight effort.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Blend 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Base 4, 2 cubes Booster D, chocolate, peanut butter, and broth until smooth.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Brown the protein in 1 tbsp oil 4 minutes per side.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Pour in the sauce and simmer 12 minutes until the meat is cooked and the sauce is thick.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Sprinkle with sesame seeds; serve with rice or tortillas.

recipes.title: Chilaquiles Rojos with Fried Eggs
recipes.description: Tortilla chips simmered briefly in red chile sauce, topped with fried eggs, crema, and onion.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Simmer 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, and the tomatoes with 1/2 cup water 4 minutes.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Stir the chicken into the sauce.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add the chips and toss 1 minute until coated but still crunchy.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Top with fried eggs, crema, queso fresco, and onion.

recipes.title: Huevos Rancheros
recipes.description: Crisp tortillas with refried beans, fried eggs, and a warm ranchero sauce.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Simmer 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, and the tomatoes 4 minutes.

steps.title: Tortillas
steps.text: Crisp the tortillas in a little oil. Warm the beans.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread beans on tortillas, top with eggs and sauce, and finish with avocado.

recipes.title: Frijoles Charros
recipes.description: Smoky "cowboy" pinto beans simmered with bacon, tomato, and chiles. A meal on its own with tortillas.

steps.title: Bacon
steps.text: Render the bacon in a pot until crisp.

steps.title: Vegetarian start
steps.text: Use 2 tbsp oil instead of bacon.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, the tomato, and jalapeño; cook 3 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the beans with liquid; simmer 20 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Season and serve with tortillas and cilantro.

recipes.title: Salsa Verde Chicken & Rice Skillet
recipes.description: Chicken and rice baked in tangy salsa verde, smothered in melted cheese. One skillet, no fuss.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Brown the seasoned chicken 4 minutes per side. Remove.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Toast the rice with 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster D 1 minute.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Add the salsa verde and broth, nestle in the chicken, cover, and simmer 18 minutes.

steps.title: Cheese
steps.text: Top with cheese, cover 2 minutes to melt.

recipes.title: Street Corn Chicken Salad
recipes.description: Charred corn, chicken, and black beans tossed in a creamy, smoky, lime-spiked dressing with cotija.

steps.title: Char
steps.text: Char the corn in a dry skillet over high 6–8 minutes.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster D; whisk with lime juice.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the corn, protein, romaine, and dressing. Top with cotija.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Fajitas
recipes.description: Sizzling smoky strips of protein with peppers and onions, all roasted on one pan.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster D; toss with the protein, vegetables, 2 tbsp oil, and 1 tsp salt.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Spread on a sheet pan and roast at 450°F for 18–20 minutes, broiling the last 2 minutes for char.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve in warm tortillas with sour cream and lime.

recipes.title: Al Pastor-Style Pork Tacos
recipes.description: Chile-and-pineapple marinated pork, seared until caramelized and tucked into tortillas with fresh pineapple.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Base 2 and 2 cubes Booster D; mix with pineapple juice and 1 tsp salt. Coat the meat.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear in a very hot skillet in batches, 3 minutes per side, until charred. Chop.

steps.title: Pineapple
steps.text: Char the pineapple in the same pan 3 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve in tortillas with pineapple, onion, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Sopa de Fideo
