recipes.description: Toasted thin noodles in a light tomato broth. Mexican chicken-noodle soup comfort.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast the noodles in 2 tbsp oil over medium, stirring, 3 minutes until golden.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster D; stir 1 minute.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the tomatoes, broth, and protein; simmer 8 minutes until the noodles are tender.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with lime and avocado.

recipes.title: Cornbread Tamale Pie
recipes.description: A spicy, saucy chili-like filling baked under a golden cornbread crust.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Brown the protein 6 minutes in an oven-safe skillet. Add 2 cubes Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, beans, and tomato sauce; simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Bean-only
steps.text: Skip the meat and use 3 cans of beans.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Mix the cornbread mix with egg, milk, and half the cheese.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread over the filling, top with remaining cheese, and bake at 400°F for 20–22 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Lime Shrimp Ceviche Tostadas
recipes.description: Bright, citrusy chopped shrimp with tomato, cucumber, and avocado on crunchy tostadas.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Poach the shrimp in simmering salted water 2–3 minutes until just pink. Chill in ice water and chop.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster D; mix with lime juice and salt.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the shrimp, tomato, and cucumber with the dressing; rest 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile onto tostadas and top with avocado.

recipes.title: Calabacitas con Pollo
recipes.description: Tender summer squash, corn, and chicken in a light, smoky tomato sauce with melted cheese.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Brown the chicken in 1 tbsp oil 5 minutes.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Add the zucchini, corn, tomato, 1 cube Base 1, and 1 cube Booster D; cook 6–8 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with queso fresco and serve with tortillas.

recipes.title: Mexican Picadillo
recipes.description: Savory ground meat with potatoes and carrots in a tomato sauce. Spoon into tortillas or over rice.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the meat 6 minutes.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Add the potato, carrot, 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, tomato sauce, and 1/2 cup water.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Cover and simmer 12 minutes until the potatoes are tender.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over rice or in tortillas.

recipes.title: Creamy Chipotle Chicken Pasta
recipes.description: Penne in a smoky, creamy chipotle sauce with seared chicken and sweet corn.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.text: Cook the pasta, reserving 1 cup water.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear the protein 6 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 2 cubes Base 4, 1 cube Booster D, corn, and 1/2 cup pasta water; simmer 2 minutes.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add pasta and parmesan; toss until creamy.

recipes.title: Freezer Breakfast Burritos
recipes.description: Big-batch burritos stuffed with smoky eggs, potatoes, cheese, and your choice of filling. Microwave straight from frozen.

steps.title: Potatoes
steps.text: Crisp the hash browns in 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high, 8 minutes. Remove.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Brown the sausage 6 minutes (beans: warm 2 minutes). Add 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D and stir until coated.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Push aside, add the beaten eggs, and scramble until just set.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Divide the potatoes, filling, eggs, and cheese among tortillas; roll tightly, folding in the ends.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.text: Wrap each in foil. Reheat from frozen: unwrap, wrap in a damp paper towel, and microwave 2–3 minutes.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Migas
recipes.description: Soft scrambled eggs with crispy tortilla strips, salsa, and cheese. A ten-minute Texas breakfast.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Fry the tortilla strips in 2 tbsp oil over medium-high 3 minutes until crisp.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D; stir 30 seconds.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Add the beaten eggs and scramble 2 minutes until just set. Fold in the cheese.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with salsa and cilantro.

recipes.title: Chorizo-Spiced Turkey & Potato Hash
recipes.description: Crispy potatoes and smoky chorizo-spiced meat, crowned with eggs. A hearty weekend breakfast.

steps.title: Par-cook
steps.text: Microwave the potatoes covered 4 minutes.

steps.title: Meat
steps.text: Brown the meat in 1 tbsp oil with the paprika, 1 cube Base 1, and 1 cube Booster D, 5 minutes.

steps.title: Egg-only
steps.text: Skip the meat and add an extra 2 eggs.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Add the potatoes and cook 6 minutes until golden.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Make wells, add the eggs, cover, and cook 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Smoky Black Bean Breakfast Tostadas
recipes.description: Crunchy tostadas with smoky mashed black beans, a runny egg, avocado, and hot sauce.

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: Warm the beans with 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, and 2 tbsp water; mash.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread beans on tostadas, top with eggs and avocado, and add hot sauce.

recipes.title: Chipotle Sweet Potato Breakfast Bowls
recipes.description: Roasted sweet potatoes and black beans in a smoky-creamy chipotle sauce, topped with eggs.

steps.title: Potatoes
steps.text: Microwave the sweet potato covered 4 minutes, then crisp in 1 tbsp oil 6 minutes.

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: Add the beans and warm through.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster D 20 seconds; stir smooth.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Bowl the potatoes and beans, top with fried eggs and avocado, and drizzle with sauce.

recipes.title: Smoky Queso Dip
recipes.description: Molten, smoky cheese dip with seasoned beef (or black beans). Game-day essential in ten minutes.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the beef 5 minutes.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster D.

steps.title: Melt
steps.text: Add the milk and cheeses over low heat, stirring until smooth and glossy.

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: Stir in the beans.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with chips.

recipes.title: Seven-Layer Bean Dip
recipes.description: The party classic: smoky beans, guacamole, chipotle crema, salsa, cheese, and more in neat layers.

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: Microwave the beans with 1 cube Booster D 1 minute; stir and spread in a dish.

steps.title: Guac
steps.text: Mash the avocados with 1 cube Base 3 (thawed) and salt; spread over the beans.

steps.title: Crema
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 4 and stir into the sour cream; spread over.

steps.title: Layers
steps.text: Top with salsa, cheese, and olives. Serve with chips.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Nachos
recipes.description: Loaded nachos with smoky chicken, beans, melty cheese, and all the toppings.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Warm 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D with the protein (brown beef first 5 minutes) and beans.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread chips on a sheet pan, top with filling and cheese.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 425°F for 8 minutes until melted.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Add jalapeño, sour cream, and salsa.

recipes.title: Baked Chipotle Chicken Taquitos
recipes.description: Crispy rolled tortillas stuffed with creamy chipotle chicken (or beans). Oven-baked, dunkable.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Mix the protein with 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D (softened), cream cheese, and Jack.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Warm tortillas, add filling, roll tightly, and place seam-down on an oiled sheet pan.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Brush with oil and bake at 425°F for 15 minutes until crisp.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with guacamole and salsa.

recipes.title: Texas-Style Beef Chili
recipes.description: A deep, beefy, no-bean bowl of red with tender chunks of chuck. Top with cheese and onions.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in a Dutch oven.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 2 cubes Base 2, and 2 cubes Booster D; stir 2 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the tomatoes and broth; simmer 40 minutes (ground beef: 20) until tender.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Stir in the masa and simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with cheese and onions; serve with cornbread.

recipes.title: Creamy White Chicken Chili
recipes.description: A creamy, mild green-chile chili with white beans and shredded chicken.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 3, and 1 cube Booster D with the cumin.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the broth, beans, and chiles.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken and simmer 15 minutes; shred and return.

steps.title: Turkey
steps.text: Add the turkey and simmer 10 minutes.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Stir in 1 cube Base 4 and mash some beans to thicken.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with chips, cilantro, and lime.

recipes.title: 20-Minute Turkey & Bean Chili
recipes.description: Lean turkey, three beans, and smoky chiles in a quick, thick chili. Weeknight-fast, meal-prep friendly.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the turkey 6 minutes (beans-only: skip).

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster D.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the beans, tomatoes, and broth; simmer 15 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with yogurt and scallions.

recipes.title: Smoky BBQ Pulled Chicken Sandwiches
recipes.description: Tender pulled chicken in a smoky homemade barbecue sauce on soft buns with crunchy slaw.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Simmer 1 cube Base 2, 2 cubes Booster D, ketchup, sugar, vinegar, and 1/2 cup water 3 minutes.

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: Add the meat, cover, and simmer 15–18 minutes until cooked.

steps.title: Shred
steps.text: Shred with forks and toss in the sauce.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile onto buns with slaw.

recipes.title: Chipotle Turkey Burgers with Avocado
recipes.description: Juicy, smoky turkey burgers topped with pepper Jack, avocado, and chipotle mayo.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix the meat with 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D (softened) and 3/4 tsp salt. Form 4 patties.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Grill or sear 4–5 minutes per side; add cheese to melt.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 4 for a chipotle-cream spread.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Build on buns with avocado and sauce.

recipes.title: Smoky Chicken & Rice Casserole
recipes.description: A cheesy, creamy, Tex-Mex chicken and rice bake. Family-friendly and freezer-ready.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster D with the broth; stir smooth.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Combine rice, protein, corn, sauce, and half the cheese in a baking dish.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Top with remaining cheese and bake at 375°F for 25–30 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.title: Cajun Shrimp & Sausage Skillet
recipes.description: Shrimp and smoked sausage with peppers and onions in a spicy Creole-style tomato sauce over rice.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the sausage 4 minutes.

steps.title: Trinity
steps.text: Add the pepper and celery; cook 4 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, 1 cube Booster A, and tomatoes; simmer 4 minutes.

steps.title: Shrimp
steps.text: Add the shrimp and cook 3 minutes. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Red Beans & Rice
recipes.description: Creamy, smoky New Orleans red beans with sausage over white rice. Monday-night tradition.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the sausage 4 minutes.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Add the celery, pepper, 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, and 1 cube Booster A.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the beans with liquid and 1 cup water; simmer 25 minutes, mashing some beans.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over rice with hot sauce.

recipes.title: Smoky Shrimp & Cheesy Grits
recipes.description: Creamy cheddar grits topped with smoky, buttery shrimp. A Southern classic for brunch or dinner.

steps.title: Grits
steps.text: Simmer the grits in 4 cups salted water 15 minutes, stirring. Stir in 1 cube Base 4 and the cheddar.

steps.title: Shrimp
steps.text: Sear the shrimp in butter 2 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster D, and 2 tbsp water; toss 1 minute.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon shrimp over grits with scallions.

recipes.title: Chipotle Meatloaf Bites
recipes.description: Mini muffin-tin meatloaves with a smoky-sweet glaze. Faster than a full loaf.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix the meat, panko, egg, 1 cube Base 2 (softened), and 1 tsp salt. Press into 12 muffin cups.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Mix 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D (softened), and ketchup; spread on top.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 425°F for 18–20 minutes until 160°F (turkey 165°F).

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Taco Pasta Skillet
recipes.description: Creamy, cheesy, taco-seasoned pasta made in one skillet. Kid-approved weeknight hero.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the meat 5 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, pasta, and broth. Cover and simmer 11 minutes, stirring once.

steps.title: Cream
steps.text: Stir in 1 cube Base 4 and the cheese.

recipes.title: Chili-Lime Roasted Chickpeas
recipes.description: Crunchy chickpeas with a smoky chili-lime coating. Salty, tangy, and highly snackable.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Toss the chickpeas with oil and salt; roast at 425°F for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster D; toss with the chickpeas and roast 5 more minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Zest lime over the top.

recipes.title: Smoky Black Bean Avocado Toast
recipes.description: Hearty toast layered with smoky beans, smashed avocado, and an optional egg.

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: Warm the beans with 1 cube Booster D 1 minute and mash.

steps.title: Avocado
steps.text: Mash the avocado with 1 cube Base 3 (thawed) and salt.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Toast the bread, layer beans and avocado, and top with eggs.

recipes.title: Chili-Lime Shrimp Wraps
recipes.description: Quick-seared smoky shrimp in crisp lettuce cups with mango and avocado.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear the shrimp 1–2 minutes per side.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster D; toss 30 seconds.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Fill lettuce with shrimp, mango, and avocado.

recipes.title: Spicy Tuna Avocado Tostadas
recipes.description: Creamy-spicy tuna on crunchy tostadas with avocado and cucumber. No cooking, big crunch.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster D 15 seconds.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix with the tuna and lime.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Top tostadas with avocado, tuna, and cucumber.

recipes.title: Southwest Chicken Wraps
recipes.description: Cooked chicken, beans, corn, and greens in a creamy chipotle-lime dressing, all wrapped up.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster D; whisk.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss protein, corn, and romaine with dressing.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Roll in tortillas.

recipes.title: Smoky Steak & Egg Breakfast Tacos
recipes.description: Leftover or quick-seared steak with scrambled eggs and salsa in warm tortillas.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear the steak 2 minutes.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D; toss 30 seconds.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Scramble the eggs in the pan.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Fill tortillas and top with salsa.

recipes.title: Loaded Chipotle Chicken Potato Skins
recipes.description: Crispy potato skins filled with smoky chicken (or bacon), cheese, and chipotle sour cream.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Microwave the potatoes 10 minutes; halve and scoop out most flesh.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Brush with oil and bake at 450°F skin-side up 10 minutes.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Mix the protein with 1 cube Booster D. Fill skins and top with cheese; bake 8 minutes.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Stir 1 cube Base 4 into the sour cream and dollop on top.

recipes.title: Chipotle Lentil Tacos
recipes.description: Smoky, meaty-textured lentil taco filling with all your favorite toppings.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Simmer the lentils with 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, and 1/3 cup water 8 minutes, mashing slightly, until thick.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Spread the lentils in a hot oiled skillet and leave 2 minutes so the bottom crisps, then stir.

steps.title: Warm tortillas
steps.text: Char the tortillas over a gas flame or in a dry pan, 20 seconds per side.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fill tortillas with lentils, lettuce, and cheese.

recipes.title: Smoky Lentil & Egg Breakfast Skillet
recipes.description: Savory smoky lentils with eggs cooked right on top. A protein-packed breakfast in one pan.

steps.title: Lentils
steps.text: Simmer lentils with 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, and 1/4 cup water 4 minutes.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Make wells, crack in eggs, cover, and cook 5 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with cheese and serve with toast.

recipes.title: Smoked Salmon Bagels with Herb Cream
recipes.description: Toasted bagels with a whipped green-herb cream cheese, silky smoked salmon, capers, and red onion.

steps.title: Herb cream
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A for 15 seconds; beat into the cream cheese until smooth and pale green.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Split and toast the bagels.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread thickly with herb cream, then top with salmon, capers, and red onion.

recipes.title: Sausage Gravy over Biscuits
recipes.description: Peppery, creamy sausage gravy poured over warm flaky biscuits. Southern Sunday breakfast.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the sausage in a skillet over medium-high 6 minutes, breaking it up.

steps.title: Roux
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A; sprinkle in the flour and stir 1 minute.

steps.title: Gravy
steps.text: Slowly stir in the milk; simmer 3–4 minutes until thick. Stir in 1 cube Base 4 and the pepper.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Split the biscuits and smother with gravy.

recipes.title: Smoky Tofu Breakfast Tacos
recipes.description: Crumbled tofu scrambled with smoky chiles and peppers, tucked into warm tortillas. Plant-based and filling.

steps.title: Peppers
steps.text: Soften the pepper in 1 tbsp oil 2 minutes.

steps.title: Scramble
steps.text: Add the tofu, turmeric, 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, and salt; cook 4 minutes until hot and golden.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon into warm tortillas with avocado and hot sauce.

recipes.title: Chicken Sausage & Sweet Potato Hash
recipes.description: Caramelized sweet potatoes, kale, and browned chicken sausage with herbs. A balanced, hearty breakfast.

steps.title: Par-cook
steps.text: Microwave the sweet potato covered with 2 tbsp water 4 minutes.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the sausage in 1 tbsp oil 4 minutes.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Add the sweet potato and cook 6 minutes until caramelized.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster A, and the kale; toss 2 minutes until wilted. Top with fried eggs if you like.

recipes.title: Savory Miso Oats with Soft Egg
recipes.description: Creamy oats cooked like congee with miso and ginger, topped with a jammy egg and scallions.

steps.title: Oats
steps.text: Simmer the oats in 1 cup water with 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B, 4 minutes, until creamy. Stir in the miso.

steps.title: Egg
steps.text: Meanwhile, soft-boil the egg 6 minutes; peel.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top the oats with the halved egg, scallions, and chili crisp.

recipes.title: Korean Egg Rice (Gyeran-bap)
recipes.description: Hot rice with crispy fried eggs, butter, and a savory soy-sesame glaze. Five-minute comfort.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B for 15 seconds; stir in the soy.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs in hot oil until the edges are crisp and lacy.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Top the rice with butter, eggs, glaze, and seaweed. Break the yolks and mix.

recipes.title: Chicken & Egg Breakfast Quesadillas
recipes.description: Crispy quesadillas filled with scrambled eggs, shredded chicken, melty cheese, and green salsa.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Scramble the eggs with 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster D until just set.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Fold in the chicken.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spread over half of each tortilla, top with cheese, and fold.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Cook in a dry skillet 2 minutes per side until golden.

recipes.title: Bistro Ham & Egg Breakfast Sandwich
recipes.description: Toasted brioche with ham, melty Gruyère, a fried egg, and a creamy Dijon spread.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster A 15 seconds; stir smooth.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs; warm the ham alongside and top it with cheese to melt.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Toast the buns, spread with sauce, and stack ham, cheese, and egg.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chickpea Breakfast Bowl
recipes.description: Warm herby chickpeas over leftover grains with tomato, cucumber, feta, and a soft egg.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Soft-boil the eggs 6 1/2 minutes.

steps.title: Chickpeas
steps.text: Warm the chickpeas in a skillet with 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A, 3 minutes.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Bowl the grains, chickpeas, tomato, and feta; top with halved eggs.

recipes.title: Masala Lentil Toast
recipes.description: Spiced, saucy lentils piled on buttered toast with yogurt and cilantro. Think beans on toast, Mumbai-style.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Warm the lentils with 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster C, and 3 tbsp water 4 minutes, mashing a few.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Meanwhile, toast the bread until deeply golden and butter it while hot.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the lentils over the toast and top with yogurt, cilantro, and a pinch of chili flakes.

recipes.title: Bistro Beef Breakfast Hash
recipes.description: Crispy potatoes and savory beef with onions in a rich glaze, topped with eggs. Diner-style hash, upgraded.

ingredients.item: cooked roast beef or corned beef

steps.title: Par-cook
steps.text: Microwave the potatoes covered 4 minutes.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Fry the potatoes in 2 tbsp oil 6 minutes. Add the beef and cook 3 minutes until browned.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster A; toss 1 minute and press flat.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Smoked Trout Potato Cakes
recipes.description: Crispy pan-fried potato cakes flecked with smoked fish and herbs, with a lemony herb cream.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix the potatoes, fish, egg, 1 cube Base 1 (softened), and pepper. Form 6 patties and coat in panko.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Fry in 2 tbsp oil over medium 4–5 minutes per side until crisp.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster A 15 seconds; stir with lemon juice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with the sauce and a fried egg if you like.

recipes.title: Ginger Tofu Breakfast Rice Bowl
recipes.description: Crispy, gingery tofu over warm rice with cucumber and herbs. A savory, plant-based start.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Fry the tofu in 1 tbsp oil over high 5 minutes until golden.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Booster B, and the soy; toss 1 minute.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over rice with cucumber and herbs.

recipes.title: Potsticker & Egg Breakfast Skillet
recipes.description: Crispy-bottomed frozen potstickers with eggs poured around them, cooked into one crunchy pancake.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Fry the potstickers flat-side down in 1 tbsp oil 2 minutes. Add 1/4 cup water, cover, and steam 4 minutes.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Whisk the eggs with 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B (softened). Pour around the dumplings, cover, and cook 2 minutes until set.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Flip onto a plate and top with scallions.

recipes.title: Turkey Bacon & Avocado Breakfast Sandwich
recipes.description: Crisp turkey bacon, a fried egg, smashed avocado, and smoky green sauce on toasted sourdough.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Cook the turkey bacon 4 minutes until crisp. Fry the eggs.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Mash the avocado with 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster D (softened).

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Toast the bread, spread with avocado, and stack bacon and egg.

recipes.title: Green Chile Chicken Breakfast Casserole
recipes.description: A make-ahead breakfast bake with hash browns, eggs, chicken, and green chiles under bubbling cheese.

steps.title: Custard
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster D 20 seconds; whisk with the eggs, milk, and 1 tsp salt.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread hash browns in a greased 9x13, top with protein, chiles, and half the cheese.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour over the custard, top with remaining cheese, and bake at 375°F for 35 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Bistro Beans on Toast
recipes.description: Rich, savory tomato-braised white beans on thick buttered toast. A British-inspired breakfast staple, upgraded.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Simmer the beans, passata, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster A 5 minutes until thick.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast the bread until crisp and butter it generously.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the beans over the hot toast and top with grated cheddar and black pepper.

recipes.title: Cheddar & Bacon Savory Oatmeal
recipes.description: Creamy oats with sharp cheddar, crisp bacon, and a fried egg. Like grits, but with oats.

steps.title: Bacon
steps.text: Cook the bacon until crisp; crumble. Fry the eggs in the drippings.

steps.title: Oats
steps.text: Simmer the oats in 2 cups water with 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A, 5 minutes. Stir in the cheddar.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with bacon and eggs.

recipes.title: Japanese-Style Salmon Breakfast Bowl
recipes.description: Flaky glazed salmon over rice with a soft egg, pickles, and seaweed. A traditional-style savory breakfast.

steps.title: Salmon
steps.text: Sear the salmon 3 minutes per side. Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, and the soy; spoon over 30 seconds.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Soft-boil the eggs 6 1/2 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve over rice with eggs and pickles.

recipes.title: Keema Breakfast Toast
recipes.description: Spiced minced meat with peas piled on toast and topped with a fried egg. A Mumbai café favorite.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the meat 5 minutes.

steps.title: Spice
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster C, and the peas; cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pile on toast and top with fried eggs.

recipes.title: Breakfast Bibimbap
recipes.description: Rice topped with quick-seared beef, sautéed spinach, a fried egg, and gochujang sauce.

steps.title: Beef
steps.text: Sear the beef 2 minutes; add 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster B and toss.

steps.title: Spinach
steps.text: Wilt the spinach with a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Fry the eggs.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Top rice with beef, spinach, and eggs; add gochujang and mix.

recipes.title: Chicken Sausage & White Bean Breakfast Skillet
recipes.description: Browned chicken sausage and creamy white beans in a garlicky tomato sauce. Toast for dunking.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the sausage 4 minutes.

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster A, the beans, and 1/4 cup water; simmer 4 minutes.

steps.title: Greens
steps.text: Stir in the spinach. Serve with toast.

recipes.title: Tex-Mex Sweet Potato Toasts
recipes.description: Toasted sweet potato slices topped with smoky beans, avocado, and salsa. Gluten-free and fun.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast the sweet potato slices in a toaster on high 2–3 cycles until tender.

steps.title: Beans
steps.text: Warm the beans with 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster D; mash.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Top slices with beans, avocado, and salsa.

recipes.title: Breakfast Ramen Omelette
recipes.description: Instant noodles crisped in a pan and bound with eggs into a savory, crunchy omelette.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Boil the ramen 2 minutes; drain well.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Fry the noodles flat in 1 tbsp oil 2 minutes.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Whisk the eggs with 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster B (softened). Pour over the noodles with the ham. Cover and cook 2 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fold and top with scallions.

recipes.title: Leftover Pasta Frittata
recipes.description: Leftover spaghetti bound with eggs and cheese, cooked into a crisp-edged Italian frittata.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk the eggs with 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster A (softened), and parmesan. Toss with the pasta.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Crisp the pancetta in the skillet 2 minutes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Add 1 tbsp oil and the pasta mixture; cook over medium 6 minutes until set underneath.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Flip onto a plate and slide back to cook 4 minutes more.

recipes.title: Breakfast Polenta with Sausage & Eggs
recipes.description: Creamy instant polenta topped with saucy sausage and soft eggs. Italian-style breakfast bowl.

steps.title: Polenta
steps.text: Whisk the polenta into 2 cups boiling salted water; cook 3 minutes. Stir in parmesan.

steps.title: Sausage
steps.text: Brown the sausage 5 minutes; add 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster A with 2 tbsp water.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Fry or poach the eggs.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Bowl the polenta, top with sausage and eggs.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice Breakfast Bowl with Sambal Egg
recipes.description: Fragrant coconut rice, crispy egg, cucumber, peanuts, and a sweet-spicy sambal. Inspired by nasi lemak.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Warm the rice with 1 cube Base 4 until creamy and fragrant.

steps.title: Sambal
steps.text: Fry the eggs. In the same pan, sizzle 1 cube Booster B with the sambal 30 seconds.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Top rice with eggs, chicken, cucumber, peanuts, and sambal.

recipes.title: Apple-Sage Chicken Breakfast Sausage
recipes.description: Lean homemade chicken sausage patties with sweet apple and sage. Freeze for busy mornings.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix the chicken with apple, sage, 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A (softened), and 3/4 tsp salt.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Form 8 patties.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook in 1 tbsp oil over medium 4–5 minutes per side to 165°F.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve on toasted English muffins.

recipes.title: Tuna Melt English Muffins
recipes.description: Creamy herbed tuna on toasted English muffins under bubbly cheddar. Breakfast, lunch, or snack.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster A 15 seconds; mix with tuna and celery.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Toast the muffins, top with tuna and cheese.

steps.title: Broil
steps.text: Broil 2–3 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.title: Tapsilog (Garlic Beef, Rice & Egg)
recipes.description: Sweet-savory garlicky beef with garlic fried rice and a sunny egg. The Filipino breakfast of champions.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Toss the beef with soy, sugar, and 1 cube Booster B (softened); 5 minutes.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Fry the garlic in 1 tbsp oil until golden; add the rice, 1 cube Base 1, and salt; fry 3 minutes.

steps.title: Beef
steps.text: Sear the beef in a hot pan 2 minutes until caramelized.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Plate the rice, beef, and a fried egg.

recipes.title: Spiced Red Lentil Hummus
recipes.description: A silky, cumin-scented dip made from red lentils instead of chickpeas. Cheaper, faster, and just as creamy.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Simmer the lentils in 2 cups salted water 12 minutes until very soft. Drain well and cool 5 minutes.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend with 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster C, tahini, lemon juice, and 2 tbsp water until silky.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Swirl into a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, and serve with pita wedges.

recipes.title: Crispy Lentil Fritters
recipes.description: Crunchy, herb-flecked lentil fritters with a cool yogurt dip. Inspired by South Indian dal vada.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mash the lentils with the chickpea flour, onion, 1 cube Booster C (softened), and 1/2 tsp salt into a thick batter.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Drop tablespoons into 1/4 inch hot oil and flatten. Fry 2–3 minutes per side until crisp.

steps.title: Dip
steps.text: Stir 1 cube Base 3 (thawed) into the yogurt.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve hot with the dip.

recipes.title: Crispy Potstickers with Ginger Dipping Sauce
recipes.description: Frozen dumplings pan-fried with a crackly bottom, with a savory ginger-scallion dipping sauce.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Arrange the potstickers flat-side down in 1 tbsp oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high. Fry 2 minutes until golden.

steps.title: Steam
steps.text: Add 1/3 cup water, cover, and steam 4–5 minutes until the water evaporates and the bottoms re-crisp.

steps.title: Dip
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B 15 seconds; stir with the soy and vinegar.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve crispy-side up with the dipping sauce.

recipes.title: Sticky Glazed Pork Belly Bites
recipes.description: Crispy-edged pork belly cubes glazed in a sweet, sticky ginger-soy sauce. Irresistible party food.

steps.title: Render
steps.text: Cook the pork belly in a dry skillet over medium, turning, 18–20 minutes until crisp and golden. Pour off most of the fat.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster B, honey, and soy; toss 2–3 minutes until sticky.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Sprinkle with sesame seeds and scallions; serve with toothpicks.

recipes.title: Mini Beef Empanadas
recipes.description: Flaky little turnovers filled with smoky, savory beef. Made easy with store-bought dough.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Brown the beef 6 minutes. Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, and olives; cook 2 minutes. Cool.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Roll out the dough and cut 3-inch circles.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spoon 1 tbsp filling onto each, fold, and crimp with a fork. Brush with egg.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 400°F for 15–18 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Bulgogi Beef Sliders
recipes.description: Sweet-savory bulgogi beef on soft slider buns with quick-pickled cucumber and spicy mayo.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Toss the beef with 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster B (softened), soy, and sugar.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Sear in a very hot skillet 4–6 minutes until caramelized.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Toast the buns, spread with spicy mayo, and pile on beef and cucumbers.

recipes.title: Salt & Pepper Tofu Bites
recipes.description: Shatteringly crisp tofu tossed with garlic, chili, and scallion. A takeout favorite at home.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Toss the tofu with cornstarch, white pepper, and 1/2 tsp salt.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Fry in 1/2 inch oil over medium-high 8–10 minutes, turning, until crisp. Drain.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Wipe the pan, fry the jalapeño with 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B for 30 seconds, then toss with the tofu.

recipes.title: Miso-Glazed Tofu Skewers
recipes.description: Charred tofu skewers brushed with a creamy, savory-sweet miso glaze.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster B 15 seconds; whisk with miso and maple.

steps.title: Skewer
steps.text: Thread the tofu onto skewers and brush with half the glaze.

steps.title: Char
steps.text: Grill or broil 8–10 minutes, turning and brushing with the remaining glaze, until charred.

recipes.title: Turkey Club Pinwheels
recipes.description: Tortillas rolled with herb cream cheese, turkey, bacon, and spinach, then sliced into spirals.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A for 15 seconds; beat into the cream cheese.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Spread over the tortillas, then layer turkey, bacon, and spinach.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Roll tightly, wrap, and chill 10 minutes if time allows.

steps.title: Slice
steps.text: Cut into 1-inch spirals.

recipes.title: Turkey Taco Wonton Cups
recipes.description: Crispy wonton wrapper cups baked in a muffin tin and filled with taco meat and cheese.

steps.title: Cups
steps.text: Press wonton wrappers into a greased mini muffin tin and bake at 375°F for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Brown the meat 6 minutes; add 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D.

steps.title: Fill and bake
steps.text: Fill the cups, top with cheese, and bake 6–7 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Dollop with sour cream.

recipes.title: Smoky Chipotle-Honey Wings
recipes.description: Oven-crisped wings tossed in a smoky, sweet, slightly spicy chipotle-honey glaze.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Pat the wings very dry and toss with baking powder and 1 tsp salt.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Arrange on a rack over a sheet pan. Bake at 425°F for 40 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, honey, and butter.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the hot wings in the glaze.

recipes.title: Spinach-Artichoke Chicken Dip
recipes.description: Hot, bubbly, creamy dip with spinach, artichokes, chicken, and parmesan.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Melt 2 cubes Base 4 and 1 cube Booster A with the cream cheese until smooth.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir in the chicken, artichokes, spinach, and half the parmesan.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Spread in a small dish, top with remaining parmesan, and bake at 400°F for 12–15 minutes until bubbly.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with baguette slices.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Meatball Skewers
recipes.description: Juicy ginger meatballs glazed in sticky teriyaki and threaded with pineapple.

steps.title: Meatballs
steps.text: Mix the meat with panko and 1 cube Booster B (softened). Roll 20 balls; bake at 425°F for 12 minutes.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Simmer 1 cube Base 2, soy, and honey 2 minutes. Toss the meatballs in the glaze.

steps.title: Skewer
steps.text: Thread meatballs and pineapple onto short skewers.

recipes.title: Soy-Marinated Jammy Eggs
recipes.description: Soft-centered eggs marinated in a savory-sweet soy and chili sauce. Eat as a snack or over rice.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Boil the eggs 6 1/2 minutes; chill in ice water and peel.

steps.title: Marinade
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B with the soy, honey, and 1/3 cup water; stir and cool.

steps.title: Soak
steps.text: Submerge the eggs with scallion and chili for at least 2 hours (or overnight).

recipes.title: Smoky Shrimp Cocktail
recipes.description: Chilled shrimp with a punchy, smoky cocktail sauce. A five-minute classic.

steps.title: Poach
steps.text: Poach the shrimp in simmering salted water 2–3 minutes until pink. Chill in ice water and peel.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D for 15 seconds; mix with ketchup, horseradish, and lemon juice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve the shrimp around the sauce with lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Golden Salmon Cakes with Herb Cream
recipes.description: Crisp, tender salmon cakes with a bright herb-cream dip. Party bites or a light dinner.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix the salmon, egg, half the panko, and 1 cube Base 1 (softened). Form 8 cakes and coat in remaining panko.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Fry in 2 tbsp oil 3–4 minutes per side.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A 15 seconds; stir with lemon juice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with the herb cream.

recipes.title: Spicy Tuna Cucumber Sushi Bites
recipes.description: Crisp cucumber rounds topped with sushi rice and creamy, spicy tuna. No rolling required.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster B 15 seconds; mix with sriracha and the tuna.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Top cucumber rounds with a little rice and a spoon of spicy tuna.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.text: Sprinkle with sesame seeds and scallions.

recipes.title: Spicy Edamame Hummus
recipes.description: Bright green, protein-packed hummus with ginger, lime, and a kick of chili.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Boil the edamame 3 minutes; drain.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend with 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Booster B, tahini, lime juice, and 3 tbsp water until smooth.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with rice crackers or vegetables.

recipes.title: Green Herb Hummus
recipes.description: Ultra-smooth hummus blended with green herbs and lemon. Ready in eight minutes.

steps.title: Soften
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A for 15 seconds.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend with chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and 3 tbsp ice water 2 minutes until whipped.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with olive oil and pita.

recipes.title: Smoky Chickpea Stuffed Avocados
recipes.description: Halved avocados filled with a zesty, smoky chickpea salad. A quick, filling snack or light lunch.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster D; mix with lime juice.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the chickpeas and tomatoes with the dressing; lightly mash a few chickpeas.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Halve the avocados and spoon in the salad.

recipes.title: Kofta Meatball Bites with Herb Yogurt
recipes.description: Little warm-spiced meatballs with a cool herb yogurt dip. Perfect for a mezze spread.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Mix the meat with parsley, 1 cube Booster C (softened), and 3/4 tsp salt. Roll 24 small balls.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Bake at 425°F for 12 minutes.

steps.title: Dip
steps.text: Stir 1 cube Base 3 (thawed) into the yogurt.

recipes.title: Sausage-Stuffed Mushrooms
recipes.description: Cremini caps filled with savory herbed sausage and parmesan, baked until golden.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Brown the sausage 5 minutes. Stir in 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A.

steps.title: Stuff
steps.text: Fill the mushroom caps and top with parmesan and panko.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 400°F for 15–18 minutes until golden and the mushrooms are tender.

recipes.title: Lentil & Walnut Pâté
recipes.description: A rich, savory, French-style spread of lentils, walnuts, and herbs. Gorgeous on crackers.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A in a skillet with the thyme, 2 minutes.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend with the lentils and walnuts until smooth. Season with salt and pepper.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Chill or serve at room temperature with toasts.

recipes.title: Mini Feta & Herb Frittata Bites
recipes.description: Fluffy two-bite frittatas with spinach, feta, and herbs. Great warm or cold.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk the eggs with 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A (softened) and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Divide spinach and feta among 24 greased mini muffin cups; pour in the eggs.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 350°F for 12–15 minutes until set.

recipes.title: Chipotle Chicken Stuffed Mini Peppers
recipes.description: Sweet mini peppers stuffed with creamy chipotle chicken (or beans) and baked until melty.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster D 15 seconds; mix with the protein and half the cheese.

steps.title: Stuff
steps.text: Fill the pepper halves and top with remaining cheese.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 425°F for 10 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.title: Bean & Cheese Pupusas
recipes.description: Thick corn cakes stuffed with smoky refried beans and gooey cheese, served with tangy slaw.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Mix the beans with 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D (softened).

steps.title: Dough
steps.text: Mix the masa, water, and 1/2 tsp salt into a soft dough. Divide into 8 balls.

steps.title: Stuff
steps.text: Flatten each ball, add beans and cheese, enclose, and pat into 1/2-inch discs.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Cook on a dry griddle over medium-high 3 minutes per side until spotted. Serve with slaw.

recipes.title: Sesame Shrimp Toast
recipes.description: Crunchy, golden toast topped with a gingery shrimp paste and sesame seeds. A dim-sum favorite.

steps.title: Paste
steps.text: Pulse the shrimp, egg white, 1 cube Base 1, and 1 cube Booster B (softened) into a paste.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Spread on bread, press into sesame seeds, and cut into triangles.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: Shallow-fry shrimp-side down 2 minutes, flip, and fry 1 minute until golden.

recipes.title: Spiced Turkey Samosa Pockets
recipes.description: Flaky triangles filled with spiced turkey (or lamb), peas, and potato. Baked, not fried.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Brown the meat 5 minutes. Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster C, potato, and peas; cook 2 minutes. Cool.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Cut the pastry into 9 squares, fill, and fold into triangles; crimp.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 400°F for 15 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve with chutney.

recipes.title: Masala Chickpea Nachos
recipes.description: Tortilla chips loaded with spiced chickpeas, cheese, yogurt, chutney, and red onion. Indian-Mexican mashup.

steps.title: Chickpeas
steps.text: Warm the chickpeas with 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C 3 minutes.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread chips on a sheet pan, top with chickpeas and cheese. Bake at 425°F for 7 minutes.

steps.title: Drizzle
steps.text: Mix 1 cube Base 4 (thawed) with the yogurt; drizzle with chutney.

recipes.title: Mojo Pork Sliders
recipes.description: Citrus-garlic pork with tangy pickles and Swiss on toasted slider buns. Inspired by Cuban sandwiches.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Toss the pork with 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Booster D (softened), orange juice, and salt.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear in a hot skillet 2 minutes per side.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Toast the buns with mustard, add pork, Swiss, and pickles; press in the hot pan 1 minute to melt.

recipes.title: Lemon-Garlic White Bean Pasta
recipes.description: Creamy, garlicky white beans melt into a lemony pasta sauce. Pantry dinner in 13 minutes.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Cook the pasta, reserving 1 cup water.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Warm 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster A, and the beans with 1/2 cup pasta water; mash a third of the beans.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add pasta, lemon zest and juice, and parmesan; toss until creamy. Fold in arugula.

recipes.title: Pasta Puttanesca with Tuna
recipes.description: A punchy tomato sauce with olives, capers, chili, and good tuna. Bold flavor from the pantry.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Cook the spaghetti.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Simmer 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster A, tomatoes, olives, capers, and chili 8 minutes.

steps.title: Tuna
steps.text: Fold in the tuna in chunks.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss with the pasta and a splash of pasta water.

recipes.title: Sausage & Broccoli Orecchiette
recipes.description: Little ear-shaped pasta with browned sausage and tender broccoli in a garlicky, peppery sauce.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Boil the pasta, adding broccoli for the last 4 minutes. Reserve 1 cup water.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the sausage 6 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster A, and 1/2 cup pasta water.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add pasta and broccoli; toss with pecorino until glossy.

recipes.title: Weeknight Carbonara
recipes.description: Silky egg-and-cheese sauce clinging to spaghetti with crispy pancetta and lots of black pepper.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Crisp the pancetta in a skillet 5 minutes. Turn off the heat.

steps.title: Mushroom swap
steps.text: For egg-only, brown 6 oz mushrooms in butter in place of pancetta.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Whisk the eggs, cheese, pepper, and 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A (softened).

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Cook the pasta; reserve 1 cup water.

steps.title: Emulsify
steps.text: Add hot pasta to the skillet off heat, pour in the egg mixture, and toss quickly with splashes of pasta water until silky — don't scramble.

recipes.title: Greek Shrimp Orzo with Feta
recipes.description: Shrimp baked into tomato orzo with feta and oregano. Inspired by Greek garides saganaki.

steps.title: Orzo
steps.text: Toast the orzo with 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster A 1 minute. Add tomatoes and broth; simmer 10 minutes.

steps.title: Shrimp
steps.text: Nestle in shrimp, cover, cook 4 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Top with feta and 1 cube Base 3 (thawed) drizzled over.

recipes.title: Spicy Creamy Tomato Rigatoni
recipes.description: The viral creamy-spicy tomato pasta, made dairy-light with Velvet Cream (no vodka needed).

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Cook the pasta; reserve water.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Brown the chicken 6 minutes (beans: warm 2 minutes).

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster A, and chili; fry 1 minute. Stir in 1 cube Base 4 and 1/2 cup pasta water.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add pasta and parmesan; toss until glossy pink.

recipes.title: Green Herb Pasta with Peas & Chicken
recipes.description: Pasta tossed in a vivid green herb-cream sauce with sweet peas and chicken. Spring in a bowl.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Cook pasta, adding peas for the last 2 minutes.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Sear the chicken 6 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A with 1/2 cup pasta water.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss with pasta, peas, and parmesan.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Top with halved soft eggs.

recipes.title: Turkey Spaghetti & Meatballs
recipes.description: Tender meatballs simmered in a rich tomato sauce over spaghetti. Sunday dinner, weeknight timing.

steps.title: Meatballs
steps.text: Mix the meat, panko, egg, half the parmesan, 1 cube Base 1 (softened), and salt. Roll 16 balls; brown 6 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 2 cubes Base 2, 1 cube Booster A, and tomatoes; simmer covered 15 minutes.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.text: Cook the spaghetti.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top the pasta with sauce, meatballs, and parmesan.

recipes.title: Velvet Mac & Cheese with Broccoli
recipes.description: Ultra-creamy stovetop mac and cheese with broccoli and ham or chicken. Kid-approved.

steps.title: Boil
steps.text: Cook the pasta, adding broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Drain.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Warm the milk with 1 cube Base 1, 2 cubes Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A; stir in the cheese off the heat.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Toss with pasta, broccoli, and protein.

recipes.title: Peanut Sesame Soba with Tofu
recipes.description: Nutty soba noodles in a creamy peanut-sesame dressing with crisp vegetables and herbed tofu.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Boil the soba 4 minutes; rinse cold.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster B 20 seconds; whisk with peanut butter and 2 tbsp water.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss noodles, vegetables, and protein with dressing.

recipes.title: Yaki Udon
recipes.description: Thick, chewy udon stir-fried with cabbage, mushrooms, and protein in a savory sauce.

steps.title: Loosen
steps.text: Microwave the udon 1 minute to loosen.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Stir-fry the protein 3 minutes; add cabbage 2 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, soy, and Worcestershire.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Add udon and toss 2 minutes.

recipes.title: Spicy Beef Noodle Soup
recipes.description: A deep, aromatic, chili-spiked beef broth with tender beef, bok choy, and wheat noodles. Taiwanese-inspired.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the beef in 1 tbsp oil.

steps.title: Broth
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 2 cubes Booster B, chili bean paste, star anise, and broth. Simmer 30 minutes (pressure-cook 20 for more tender).

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Cook the noodles and bok choy separately.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Ladle the soup over noodles.

recipes.title: Chicken Chow Mein
recipes.description: Crispy-tender noodles with chicken, cabbage, and bean sprouts in a savory soy sauce.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Boil 2 minutes, drain, and crisp in 1 tbsp oil 3 minutes.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Stir-fry the protein 4 minutes.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Add cabbage and sprouts 1 minute.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, soy, and oyster sauce; toss with noodles.

recipes.title: Green Curry Noodle Soup
recipes.description: A bright, creamy green curry broth with rice noodles, shrimp or tofu, and fresh herbs.

steps.title: Broth
steps.text: Fry the curry paste 1 minute; add 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, 1 cube Booster B, coconut milk, and broth. Simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Add the protein; simmer 3–4 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pour over cooked noodles; top with basil and lime.

recipes.title: Steak & Farro Salad with Herb Vinaigrette
recipes.description: Chewy farro, sliced steak, arugula, and shaved parmesan in a bright herb vinaigrette. Lunch with staying power.

steps.title: Farro
steps.text: Simmer the farro in salted water 15–20 minutes; drain.

steps.title: Steak
steps.text: Sear 4–5 minutes per side; rest and slice.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A; whisk with olive oil.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss farro, arugula, tomatoes, and dressing; top with steak and parmesan.

recipes.title: One-Pan Mexican Quinoa
recipes.description: Quinoa simmered with black beans, corn, tomatoes, and smoky spices, topped with avocado.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Brown the chicken 5 minutes.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, quinoa, beans, tomatoes, corn, and 1 cup water. Cover and simmer 18 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Fluff and top with avocado and cilantro.

recipes.title: Lemony Barley & Chicken Soup
recipes.description: A cozy, herby, lemony soup with chewy barley and tender chicken.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Melt 2 cubes Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A; add carrots, barley, and broth.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Add the chicken and simmer 25 minutes; shred.

steps.title: Turkey
steps.text: Simmer 25 minutes, adding the turkey for the last 5.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir in 1 cube Base 3 and lemon juice.

recipes.title: Lentil & Bulgur Kofte (Mercimek Köftesi)
recipes.description: Turkish lentil-bulgur bites shaped by hand and wrapped in lettuce with lemon. No frying needed.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Simmer the lentils in 2 cups water 12 minutes until mushy. Stir in the bulgur, cover off heat 15 minutes.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Mix in 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster C, tomato paste, herbs, and salt.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Squeeze into finger-shaped kofte.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Wrap in lettuce with lemon.

recipes.title: Ginger-Sesame Quinoa Bowls with Salmon
recipes.description: Fluffy quinoa, edamame, and crunchy vegetables with seared salmon (or tofu) in a gingery dressing.

steps.title: Quinoa
steps.text: Simmer the quinoa 15 minutes.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear the protein 3–4 minutes per side.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster B; whisk with soy.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Bowl the quinoa, edamame, carrot, and protein; drizzle with dressing.

recipes.title: Chicken Fattoush Salad
recipes.description: A crunchy Lebanese bread salad with herbs, vegetables, crispy pita, and sumac chicken.

steps.title: Chicken
steps.text: Season with sumac and salt; sear 4 minutes per side. Slice.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster C; whisk with lemon and olive oil.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss vegetables, pita, and dressing; top with protein.

recipes.title: Moussaka Skillet
recipes.description: Silky eggplant and spiced meat under a creamy topping, all in one skillet. Greek comfort, simplified.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Brush the eggplant and potato slices with oil; broil 8 minutes until golden.

steps.title: Filling
steps.text: Brown the protein; add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster A, and cinnamon. Simmer 5 minutes.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Layer potatoes, filling, and eggplant in an oven-safe skillet.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Whisk 2 cubes Base 4, the egg, and parmesan; spread over.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 400°F for 20 minutes until golden.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Za'atar Chicken & Potatoes
recipes.description: Crispy chicken thighs and potatoes roasted with za'atar, lemon, and onions. Minimal effort, big flavor.

steps.title: Coat
steps.text: Mix 1 cube Booster C (softened), za'atar, 3 tbsp oil, and salt; coat the chicken and potatoes.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Roast at 450°F for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Drizzle with 1 cube Base 3 (thawed) and lemon.

recipes.title: Egyptian Koshari
recipes.description: Cairo's beloved street food: lentils, rice, and pasta layered with spiced tomato sauce, chickpeas, and crispy onions.

steps.title: Lentils & rice
steps.text: Simmer the lentils 15 minutes, then add rice and 2 cups water; cook covered 15 minutes.

steps.title: Pasta
steps.text: Boil the pasta.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Simmer 2 cubes Base 2, 1 cube Booster C, tomato sauce, and vinegar 8 minutes.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Layer lentil rice, pasta, chickpeas, sauce, and fried onions.

recipes.title: Garlic Chicken Wraps (Shish Taouk)
recipes.description: Lemon-garlic yogurt chicken skewers wrapped in flatbread with a fluffy garlic sauce and pickles.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Mix yogurt, lemon, 1 cube Booster C, and salt; coat the chicken.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Skewer and grill 10–12 minutes.

steps.title: Garlic sauce
steps.text: Whip 1 cube Base 4 with 1 cube Base 3 and lemon.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Wrap chicken, sauce, and pickles in flatbread.

recipes.title: Spanish Potato Tortilla
recipes.description: A thick, golden potato-and-onion omelette, tender inside. Serve warm or at room temperature.

steps.title: Potatoes
steps.text: Cook potatoes in olive oil over medium, covered, 12 minutes until tender.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk eggs with 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster A, and salt; fold in potatoes.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Return to the pan and cook 5 minutes; flip and cook 3 more.

recipes.title: 10-Minute Chicken & Herb Flatbread
recipes.description: Warm flatbread layered with creamy herb sauce, chicken, mozzarella, and arugula. Faster than delivery.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 3, 1 cube Base 4, and 1 cube Booster A 15 seconds.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread on flatbreads, add chicken and cheese.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Broil 3–4 minutes until bubbly. Top with arugula.

recipes.title: 10-Minute Egg Drop Soup
recipes.description: Silky ribbons of egg in a gingery, savory broth. Light, comforting, ready in minutes.

steps.title: Broth
steps.text: Simmer the broth with 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B 3 minutes.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Stir in cornstarch slurry.

steps.title: Tofu
steps.text: Add tofu.

steps.title: Egg ribbons
steps.text: Slowly drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring gently.

recipes.title: Quick Pita Pizzas
recipes.description: Crispy pita crusts topped with savory tomato sauce, cheese, and turkey pepperoni or sausage.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster A 20 seconds.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Spread on pitas, add cheese and pepperoni.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 450°F for 6–7 minutes.

recipes.title: Smoky Chicken & Rice Soup
recipes.description: A light, smoky tomato broth with chicken, rice, and vegetables. Simple Latin-style comfort.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Melt 2 cubes Base 1 and 1 cube Booster D.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add the broth, rice, carrots, and chicken; simmer 18 minutes.

steps.title: Shred
steps.text: Shred the chicken; add lime and cilantro.

recipes.title: Butter Tofu Masala
recipes.description: Golden tofu in a rich, creamy, gently sweet tomato-butter sauce. Plant-based take on butter paneer.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Fry the tofu in 1 tbsp oil 8 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C with butter; add tomato purée and simmer 4 minutes. Stir in 2 cubes Base 4 and garam masala.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Add tofu and simmer 2 minutes. Serve with naan.

recipes.title: Korean Kimbap Bowls
recipes.description: Everything you love about kimbap — seasoned rice, sweet beef, egg, crunchy vegetables, and seaweed — in a bowl.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Toss the warm rice with sesame oil and a pinch of salt.

steps.title: Beef
steps.text: Sear the beef 2 minutes with 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B until glazed.

steps.title: Egg ribbons
steps.text: Cook the eggs into a thin omelette with 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster B mixed in; roll and slice into ribbons.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Arrange rice, protein, carrot, and cucumber in bowls; top with seaweed and sesame seeds.

recipes.title: Roast Beef & Horseradish Wraps
recipes.description: Deli roast beef with peppery horseradish cream, arugula, and pickled onions rolled into a wrap.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster A 15 seconds; stir in the horseradish.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Spread over tortillas; add roast beef, arugula, and onions.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Roll tightly and slice in half.

recipes.title: Thai Beef Salad (Yum Nua)
recipes.description: Juicy seared steak with crisp vegetables, herbs, and a fiery lime-fish sauce dressing.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear the steak 4 minutes per side. Rest 5 minutes and slice thin.

steps.title: Dressing
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster B; whisk with fish sauce and lime juice.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: Toss the steak, vegetables, and herbs with the dressing. Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Golden Turmeric Tofu Hash
recipes.description: Crispy potatoes and turmeric-golden tofu with peppers and spinach. A hearty plant-based breakfast.

steps.title: Par-cook
steps.text: Microwave the potato covered 4 minutes.

steps.title: Crisp
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Booster C in 2 tbsp oil 30 seconds; add the potatoes and pepper and cook 5 minutes.

steps.title: Tofu
steps.text: Add tofu, turmeric, and 1 cube Base 1; cook 3 minutes. Fold in spinach.

recipes.title: Smashed Chickpea & Tomato Breakfast Toast
recipes.description: Warm spiced chickpeas smashed onto toast with juicy tomatoes and a drizzle of herby oil.

steps.title: Warm
steps.text: Warm the chickpeas with 1 cube Booster C 2 minutes; smash with a fork.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Toast the bread.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread chickpeas, top with tomato, and drizzle with 1 cube Base 3 (melted with 1 tbsp oil).

recipes.title: Lentil & Egg Breakfast Burritos
recipes.description: Smoky lentils and soft scrambled eggs wrapped with cheese and salsa. Fiber-rich and filling.

steps.title: Lentils
steps.text: Warm the lentils with 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D 3 minutes.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Scramble the eggs alongside.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Fill tortillas with lentils, eggs, and cheese; roll and crisp seam-side down 1 minute.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Lemongrass Chicken Skewers
recipes.description: Fragrant, caramelized lemongrass skewers with herbs, rice, and dipping sauce.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster B; mix with fish sauce and sugar. Coat the meat 10 minutes.

steps.title: Skewer
steps.text: Thread onto skewers.

steps.title: Grill
steps.text: Grill or broil 10–12 minutes, turning, until caramelized.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with rice, herbs, and lime.

recipes.title: Weeknight Beef Rendang
recipes.description: Indonesia's rich, dry coconut-spice braise with melt-tender beef. A showstopper worth the simmer.

steps.title: Paste
steps.text: Fry 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, and 1 cube Booster C with the cinnamon and star anise 2 minutes.

steps.title: Braise
steps.text: Add the beef, coconut milk, 1 cube Base 4, and 1/2 cup water. Simmer uncovered 45 minutes, stirring more as it thickens.

steps.title: Fry
steps.text: When the sauce is almost dry, stir in the toasted coconut and fry 5 minutes until dark and clinging.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with rice.

recipes.title: Pancit Canton
recipes.description: Filipino stir-fried noodles with vegetables and meat in a savory soy sauce. Party noodles for any day.

ingredients.item: pancit canton or lo mein noodles

steps.title: Protein
steps.text: Stir-fry the protein 4 minutes.

steps.title: Vegetables
steps.text: Add vegetables 2 minutes.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, soy, and 1 cup water; bring to a boil.

steps.title: Noodles
steps.text: Add noodles and cook, tossing, until the liquid absorbs. Serve with lemon.

recipes.title: Thai Garlic-Lime Pork Chops
recipes.description: Juicy chops marinated in garlic, lime, and fish sauce, seared and served with jasmine rice and a spicy dip.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.text: Soften 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster B; mix with fish sauce and lime. Coat the chops 10 minutes.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear 5–6 minutes per side to 145°F.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Rest, slice, and serve with rice and lime.

recipes.title: Beef Shawarma Pitas
recipes.description: Thin, warm-spiced beef seared until crispy and stuffed into pitas with tahini and pickled onions.

steps.title: Spice
steps.text: Toss the meat with 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster C (softened) and salt.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear in a very hot skillet 4–6 minutes until crispy.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Whisk 1 cube Base 4 (thawed) with tahini and water.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Stuff pitas with meat, sauce, and onion.

recipes.title: Chickpea & Egg Fatteh
recipes.description: Layers of crispy pita, warm spiced chickpeas, garlicky yogurt, and soft eggs. A Levantine brunch favorite.

steps.title: Chickpeas
steps.text: Warm the chickpeas with 1 cube Booster C 3 minutes.

steps.title: Yogurt
steps.text: Mix 1 cube Base 4 (thawed) with the yogurt.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Layer pita, chickpeas, and yogurt.

steps.title: Eggs
steps.text: Top with halved eggs.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Fry the pine nuts in butter and pour over.

recipes.title: Persian Herb Rice with Salmon
recipes.description: Fragrant dill-and-herb rice with a crispy bottom, topped with spiced roasted salmon.

steps.title: Rice
steps.text: Parboil the rice 6 minutes; drain and toss with herbs and 2 cubes Base 3.

steps.title: Crispy bottom
steps.text: Melt butter in a nonstick pot, pack in the rice, cover with a towel-wrapped lid, and cook on low 20 minutes.

steps.title: Salmon
steps.text: Coat the salmon with 1 cube Booster C; roast at 425°F 10–12 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Flip out the rice and top with salmon.

recipes.title: Smoky Chickpea & Chorizo Stew
recipes.description: A Spanish-inspired smoky stew with chickpeas, chorizo, and greens. Mop it up with bread.

steps.title: Chorizo
steps.text: Fry the chorizo 3 minutes until the oil turns red.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster D, and paprika.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add chickpeas, tomatoes, and 1 cup water; simmer 12 minutes. Add kale for the last 3.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve with bread.

recipes.title: Creamy Chipotle Lentil Soup
recipes.description: Velvety, smoky lentil soup finished with a swirl of creamy chipotle. Topped with crunchy pepitas.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 1 and 1 cube Booster D.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add lentils, tomatoes, and broth; simmer 20 minutes.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Blend until smooth and stir in 1 cube Base 4.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with pepitas.

recipes.title: Herb-Roasted Turkey Breast with Pan Gravy
recipes.description: A holiday-worthy roasted turkey breast with crisp skin and a silky make-ahead gravy built from cubes.

steps.title: Herb butter
steps.text: Mash the butter with 1 cube Booster A (softened) and 1 tsp salt. Rub under and over the skin.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Roast at 425°F for 15 minutes, then 350°F for 45 minutes until 160°F. Rest 15 minutes (it climbs to 165°F).

steps.title: Gravy
steps.text: Pour off the drippings into a saucepan. Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster A, and flour; whisk 1 minute. Whisk in broth and simmer 5 minutes. Stir in 1 cube Base 4.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Slice and serve with mashed potatoes and gravy.

recipes.title: Glazed Ham Steaks
recipes.description: Thick ham steaks glazed with a savory-sweet mustard-onion glaze. Dinner or brunch in fifteen minutes.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear the ham steaks 3 minutes per side.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2, 1 cube Booster A, sugar, Dijon, and 2 tbsp water; spoon over 2 minutes until sticky.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Cut into portions and serve with potatoes or eggs.

recipes.title: Turkey Cranberry Herb Sandwich
recipes.description: The best leftover sandwich: turkey, cranberry sauce, and herb cream on crusty bread.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Microwave 1 cube Base 4 and 1 cube Booster A 15 seconds.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread bread with herb cream and cranberry, layer turkey and arugula.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Press together and slice.

recipes.title: Pumpkin & Black Bean Chili
recipes.description: A cozy autumn chili with pumpkin purée, black beans, and warm smoky spices.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the turkey 6 minutes.

steps.title: Base
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Base 2, and 1 cube Booster D.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Add beans, pumpkin, tomatoes, and broth; simmer 20 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Top with yogurt and pepitas.

recipes.title: Greek Lemon Chicken Soup (Avgolemono)
recipes.description: Silky, tangy Greek egg-lemon soup with rice and shredded chicken.

steps.title: Simmer
steps.text: Melt 2 cubes Base 1 and 1 cube Booster A; add broth, rice, and chicken; simmer 15 minutes. Shred the chicken.

steps.title: Temper
steps.text: Whisk the eggs and lemon juice; slowly whisk in 2 ladles of hot broth.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Stir the egg mixture into the pot over low heat until silky (don't boil). Swirl in 1 cube Base 3.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Salmon Bites
recipes.description: Golden, buttery salmon cubes with garlic and lemon. Ten minutes, zero fuss.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Season the salmon and sear 4–5 minutes, turning, until golden.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add butter, 1 cube Base 1, and 1 cube Booster A; toss 30 seconds.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Squeeze lemon over.

recipes.title: 5-Minute Ginger Chicken Noodle Cup
recipes.description: A desk-lunch noodle cup with real flavor: ginger broth, rice noodles, chicken, and greens.

steps.title: Pack
steps.text: Layer 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, noodles, protein, and spinach in a heat-proof jar.

steps.title: Pour
steps.text: Add 1 1/2 cups boiling water; cover 4 minutes.

steps.title: Stir
steps.text: Stir and eat.

recipes.title: 5-Minute Masala Chickpea Wraps
recipes.description: Spiced smashed chickpeas with crunchy veggies and yogurt rolled in a warm tortilla.

steps.title: Warm
steps.text: Warm the chickpeas with 1 cube Booster C 2 minutes; mash.

steps.title: Sauce
steps.text: Stir 1 cube Base 3 (thawed) into the yogurt.

steps.title: Wrap
steps.text: Fill tortillas with chickpeas, cucumber, and sauce.

recipes.title: 10-Minute Chipotle Shrimp Rice Bowls
recipes.description: Smoky glazed shrimp over rice with corn, avocado, and lime.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear shrimp 2 minutes.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster D; toss 1 minute.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Serve over rice with corn and avocado.

recipes.title: Sesame Turkey & Green Bean Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Crispy ground turkey and blistered green beans in a sticky sesame-ginger sauce. Ten minutes flat.

steps.title: Blister
steps.text: Stir-fry the beans in 1 tbsp oil over high 3 minutes. Remove.

steps.title: Brown
steps.text: Brown the meat 3 minutes.

steps.title: Glaze
steps.text: Add 1 cube Base 1, 1 cube Booster B, and the beans; toss 1 minute. Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Bistro Steak Sandwich with Onion Jam
recipes.description: Thin-sliced seared steak on crusty bread with sweet onion jam and creamy garlic aioli.

steps.title: Sear
steps.text: Sear the steak 3–4 minutes per side. Rest and slice thin.

steps.title: Jam
steps.text: Melt 1 cube Base 2 and 1 cube Booster A in the pan 1 minute.

steps.title: Aioli
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 4.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: Spread bread with aioli and onion jam, layer steak and arugula.

recipes.title: Lentil & Feta Stuffed Pitas
recipes.description: Herby lentils, feta, cucumber, and tomato in pita pockets. A five-minute Mediterranean lunch.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Thaw 1 cube Base 3 and 1 cube Booster A; toss with the lentils.

steps.title: Fold
steps.text: Fold in feta and cucumber.

steps.title: Stuff
steps.text: Fill the pitas.
